title: Australian miners rail against looming tax changes
zh_title: 澳大利亚矿商强烈反对即将到来的税收改革
summary: 澳大利亚矿业高管和行业团体正在加大对联邦政府的压力，要求联邦政府免除矿产勘探者计划中的资本利得税（CGT）改革，他们警告称，这可能会损害投资并削弱该国的全球竞争力。财长吉姆·查尔默斯 (Jim Chalmers) 在 2026 年 5 月的联邦预算中宣布的改革将以成本基础指数化取代长期存在的 50% 企业所得税折扣，并对 2027 年 7 月 1 日起产生的收益征收 30% 的最低税。政府向科技初创企业提供豁免，但在 9 月确认勘探公司不会取消
content:
澳大利亚矿业高管和行业团体正在加大对联邦政府的压力，要求联邦政府免除矿产勘探者计划中的资本利得税（CGT）改革，他们警告称，这可能会损害投资并削弱该国的全球竞争力。财政部长吉姆·查尔默斯 (Jim Chalmers) 在 2026 年 5 月的联邦预算中宣布的改革将用成本基础指数化取代长期存在的 50% 资本利得税折扣，并对自 2027 年 7 月 1 日起产生的收益征收 30% 的最低税。政府向科技初创企业提供豁免，但在 9 月确认勘探公司不会获得同样的待遇。 “资本利得税太可怕了，”Evolution Mining (ASX: EVN) 创始人兼董事长 Jake Klein 在悉尼举行的国际矿业和资源大会 (IMARC) 上表示。这场争端发生之际，澳大利亚面临着绿地勘探不断减少和全球矿业资本竞争日益激烈的局面。行业领袖认为，改革将阻止投资者支持早期发现，可能会削弱支持未来矿产生产所需的项目管道。勘探面临风险 澳大利亚矿产委员会首席经济学家罗斯·兰比表示，改革未能认识到与矿产勘探相关的高风险和低成功率。 “探索绝对至关重要。我们必须做更多的事情，”他告诉 IMARC 小组。
兰比表示，投资者接受了勘探企业亏损的可能性，因为成功的发现可以带来丰厚的回报。拟议的税收安排将减少这些潜在的回报。 “这是糟糕的政策。我们已要求政府将初级探险家与创新型初创企业同等对待，并鉴于该行业的独特特征给予该行业让步，但到目前为止，政府对此置若罔闻。”西澳大利亚州矿产和能源商会首席执行官亚伦·莫雷表示，这些变化也与澳大利亚发展其关键矿产行业的雄心相冲突。莫雷指出，安东尼·阿尔巴内塞总理访问白宫，与美国官员的讨论重点是推进矿产项目。 “这项政策从根本上违背了这一愿景，”他说。采矿和勘探公司协会也对改革提出了挑战。尽管政府已就该立法展开新一轮磋商，但该协会警告称，如果不进行实质性修改，这一过程将毫无意义。行业影响 此前曾批评澳大利亚政府政策的克莱因表示，税收改革是该行业面临的几项政策阻力之一。他说：“像我 30 年前那样，今天开始职业生涯的人，没有理由表现得比我差 25%，这完全没有道理。”
Westgold Resources (ASX/TSX: WGX)董事总经理Wayne Bramwell将拟议的改革描述为“自己的目标”，会损害澳大利亚的勘探行业。“联邦关于资本利得税的决定——以不同于初创企业的方式对待澳大利亚的勘探——绝对会给这个国家带来糟糕的结果，”他在IMARC间隙表示。布拉姆韦尔表示，这种影响已经在西澳大利亚州显现出来，西澳大利亚州是该国最大的勘探支出目的地。 “这个国家最大的勘探资金目的地已经开始枯竭，因为现在从事高风险工作的人们没有因此而得到回报，”

【原文 English Original】
Australian mining executives and industry groups are intensifying pressure on the federal government to exempt mineral explorers from planned capital gains tax (CGT) changes they warn could undermine investment and weaken the country’s global competitiveness. The reforms, announced by Treasurer Jim Chalmers in the May 2026 federal budget, would replace the longstanding 50% CGT discount with cost base indexation and a 30% minimum tax on gains accruing from July 1, 2027. The government granted exemptions to technology start-ups but confirmed in September that exploration companies would not receive the same treatment. “The capital gains tax is terrible,” Evolution Mining (ASX: EVN) founder and chairman Jake Klein said during the International Mining and Resources Convention (IMARC) in Sydney. The dispute comes as Australia faces declining greenfields exploration and growing competition for global mining capital. Industry leaders argue the reforms would discourage investors from backing early-stage discoveries, potentially weakening the pipeline of projects needed to support future mineral production. Exploration at risk Minerals Council of Australia chief economist Ross Lambie said the reforms failed to recognize the high risks and low success rates associated with mineral exploration. “Exploration is absolutely critical. We’ve got to be doing more of it,” he told an IMARC panel. Lambie said investors accepted the possibility of losing money on exploration ventures because successful discoveries could deliver substantial returns. The proposed tax arrangements would diminish those potential rewards. “This is bad policy. We have asked the government to treat junior explorers the same as innovative start-ups and give the industry a concession, given the unique characteristics it has, but so far, that’s fallen on deaf ears.” Chamber of Minerals and Energy of Western Australia CEO Aaron Morey said the changes also conflicted with Australia’s ambitions to develop its critical minerals industry. Morey pointed to Prime Minister Anthony Albanese’s visit to the White House , where discussions with US officials focused on advancing minerals projects. “That is a policy that is fundamentally at odds with that vision,” he said. The Association of Mining and Exploration Companies has also challenged the reforms. Although the government has opened another round of consultation on the legislation, the association warned the process would be meaningless without substantive changes. Industry fallout Klein, who has previously criticized Australian government policy , said the tax overhaul was among several policy headwinds confronting the sector. “There is no reason why someone starting their career today, as I did 30 years ago, is going to do 25% worse than I did – that just makes no sense at all,” he said. Westgold Resources (ASX/TSX: WGX) managing director Wayne Bramwell described the proposed changes as an “own goal” that would damage Australia’s exploration industry. “Federal decisions around capital gains tax – treating exploration in Australia differently than start-ups – absolutely leads to a bad outcome for this country,” he said on the sidelines of IMARC. Bramwell said the effects were already emerging in Western Australia, the country’s largest destination for exploration spending. “The largest destination for exploration dollars in this country has started to dry up because the people doing the high-risk work now are not being rewarded for that,” he said. He warned that the consequences could extend well beyond the immediate investment cycle, potentially damaging the exploration ecosystem for years. “That’s a real concern for me, thinking that our ecosystem has been damaged long-term by that decision. It can be reversed because we absolutely need the explorers to explore.” The latest consultation gives the government another opportunity to reconsider the treatment of junior explorers before the reforms take effect in July 2027. Whether it grants the sector relief could influence Australia’s ability to attract the risk capital needed to discover its next generation of mines.

title: U.S. Delivers New F-16 Fighter Batch to the Republic of China Air Force: Are They Already Obsolete?
zh_title: 美国向中华民国空军交付新一批F-16战斗机：它们已经过时了吗？
summary: 中华民国空军已接收从美国购买的第二批三架 F-16C/D Block 70 战斗机，根据一项旨在实现其作战机队现代化的重大计划，交付工作仍在继续。据空军消息，这架编号为6729、6731和6732的飞机于11月8日抵达台东县志航空军基地，于当地时间上午11时左右降落。继 10 月 2 日首批两架战斗机抵达后，最新交付使该计划接收的飞机总数达到五架。这三架飞机从洛克希德·马公司起飞
content:
中华民国空军已接收从美国购买的第二批三架 F-16C/D Block 70 战斗机，根据一项旨在实现其作战机队现代化的重大计划，交付工作仍在继续。据空军消息，这架编号为6729、6731和6732的飞机于11月8日抵达台东县志航空军基地，于当地时间上午11时左右降落。继 10 月 2 日首批两架战斗机抵达之后，最新的交付使该计划接收的飞机总数达到五架。这三架飞机于 11 月初从洛克希德·马丁公司位于南卡罗来纳州的生产设施出发，并于 11 月 4 日抵达夏威夷。美国批准在 2019 年向中华民国出售 66 架 F-16C/D Block 70 战斗机及相关设备，合同价值约为 82 亿美元。最初预计交付将于 2023 年开始，2026 年结束，但由于一系列生产和技术问题而推迟了交付。中华民国国防部7月证实，正在向美国及其新型战斗机制造商洛克希德·马丁公司寻求赔偿。然而，销售合同并未包含经济处罚条款。
中华民国国防部此前将部分困难归咎于订购的配置包含了需要进行广泛飞行测试和校准的新系统组合。因 F-16 延迟交付而提出的赔偿要求绝非史无前例，总理赵正台曾于 2025 年 10 月表示，政府不排除“对制造商采取法律行动”。这些交付并非孤立的，截至 2025 年 12 月，未向中华民国武装部队交付的美国装备积压已超过 214.5 亿美元。更广泛地说，由于美国的主要工业限制，向多个国防客户的设备交付已大大推迟，而美国武装部队因针对伊朗的战争而自身的短缺又加剧了这种情况。一个例子是，由于美国海军严重短缺，日本首批 400 枚 RGM-109 战斧巡航导弹被无限期暂停交付。日本政府审计委员会一月份透露，五年多前根据对外军售计划从美国购买的价值约 1.1 万亿日元（合 69 亿美元）的军事装备尚未交付。
中华民国是过去十年中唯一订购 F-16 的发达经济体，在订购 F-35 第五代战斗机的不懈努力始终失败后，才做出了采购该飞机的决定。中华民国由于几乎完全缺乏国际认可，实际上作为非国家行为体的地位是其中的一个主要因素，美国继续承认总部位于北京的中华人民共和国（PRC）是唯一合法的中国政府。中国已经研制了自己的第五代战斗机，其中最著名的是歼20空优战斗机，并计划在2030年左右将世界上第一架第六代战斗机投入使用。因此，正在交付的F-16在交付之前就基本上已经过时了，采购这些飞机很大程度上反映了缺乏

【原文 English Original】
The Republic of China Air Force has received a second batch of three F-16C/D Block 70 fighter aircraft purchased from the United States, as deliveries continue under a major program intended to modernise its combat fleet. The aircraft, numbered 6729, 6731 and 6732, arrived at Chihhang Air Base in Taitung County on November 8, landing at approximately 11 a.m. local time, according to the Air Force. The latest delivery brings the total number of aircraft received under the program to five, following the arrival of the first two fighters on October 2. The three aircraft departed from Lockheed Martin’s production facility in South Carolina earlier in November and reached Hawaii on November 4. The United States approved the sale of 66 F-16C/D Block 70 fighters and associated equipment to the Republic of China in 2019, under a contract valued at approximately $8.2 billion. Deliveries were initially expected to begin in 2023 and conclude by 2026, but a wide range of production and technical problems have delayed this. The Republic of China Ministry of National Defence in July confirmed that it was seeking compensation from the United States and the manufacturer of its new fighters Lockheed Martin. The sale contract did not contain financial penalty provisions, however. The Republic of China Ministry of National Defense previously attributed some of the difficulty to the fact that the configuration ordered incorporated a new combination of systems requiring extensive flight testing and calibration. Compensation claims over delayed F-16 deliveries are far from unprecedented, with Premier Cho Jung-tai having in October 2025 stated that the government did not rule out “taking legal action against the manufacturer.” The deliveries are far from isolated, with outstanding backlogs of undelivered U.S. equipment to the Republic of China Armed Forces having in December 2025 reached over $21.45 billion. More broadly, equipment deliveries to multiple defence clients have been delayed considerably due to major industrial constraints in the United States, with this having been exacerbated by the U.S. Armed Forces’ own shortages due to the war effort against Iran. An example was the indefinite suspension of the delivery of Japan’s first 400 RGM-109 Tomahawk cruise missiles, due to serious shortages of the missiles in the U.S. Navy. The Japanese government Board of Audit revealed in January that military equipment worth approximately 1.1 trillion yen ($6.9 billion) purchased from the U.S. under the Foreign Military Sales program more than five years ago had yet to be delivered . The Republic of China is the only developed economy to have ordered F-16s in the last decade, with the decision to procure the aircraft having been made after persistent efforts to oder the F-35 fifth generation fighter consistently failed. The Republic of China’s status as effectively a non-state actor, due to its almost total lack of international recognition, has been a primary factor in this, with the United States continuing to recognise the Beijing-based People’s Republic of China (PRC) as the sole legitimate Chinese government. The PRC has developed its own fifth generation fighters, most notably the J-20 air superiority fighter, and is scheduled to introduce the world’s first sixth generation fighters into service around 2030. The F-16s being delivered are thus largely obsolete before they have even been delivered, with the procurement of the aircraft largely reflecting a lack of alternative options.

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits to having an affair with suspected Chinese spy
zh_title: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认与疑似中国间谍有染
summary: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认与一名据称是中国间谍的女子有染。他在写给 Nvidia 员工的一封信中表达了歉意，您可以在下面阅读该信的全文。英伟达董事会周日晚间发表声明，回应美国情报部门认为黄与中国间谍有染的爆炸性报道。该委员会表示，没有理由相信敏感的公司信息或美国国家安全受到损害，但该公司打算检查所有可用信息以确定发生了什么。董事会声称对 Je 充满信心
content:
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认与一名据称是中国间谍的女子有染。他在写给 Nvidia 员工的一封信中表达了歉意，您可以在下面阅读该信的全文。英伟达董事会周日晚间发表声明，回应美国情报部门认为黄与中国间谍有染的爆炸性报道。该委员会表示，没有理由相信敏感的公司信息或美国国家安全受到损害，但该公司打算检查所有可用信息以确定发生了什么。董事会声称对黄仁勋及其领导团队充满信心。与妻子 Lori Huang 结婚 41 年的黄表示，他完全支持调查。英伟达董事会在一份声明中写道：“一个由独立董事组成的委员会将在外部独立顾问的协助下监督调查。” “董事会优先考虑美国国家和经济安全，这对 Nvidia 及其股东的利益至关重要。[……] Jensen 完全支持此次审查，并承诺与其合作。”周五，第一份报道称，美国情报机构认为黄与爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang，又名黄乐）有恋爱关系，黄乐是新加坡 Megaspeed 的前高管，据称被中国国家安全部 (MSS) 招募来收集信息并帮助中国公司获取受限制的人工智能 GPU。
至少从 2025 年起，该公司就因向中国走私受限制的硬件而受到关注：Megaspeed 被指控通过其子公司 Speedmatrix 向中国走私价值 20 亿美元的 AI 芯片。对于 NVIDIA 的同事，我欠我的家人和你们所有人一个道歉。英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋坚决否认有关不当交易的指控，称其首席执行官定期会见数千名客户，并且这些互动不涉及敏感的公司信息或国家安全机密。中国官员也驳斥了间谍指控，称其毫无根据。涉嫌针对詹森的中国情报行动尚未得到独立证实。据称，这种关系遵循典型的“蜜罐”策略，即外国情报机构利用特工诱骗目标建立恋爱关系，以窃取信息并影响他们的决策。黄仁勋一直直言不讳地批评那些反对限制向中国供应人工智能 GPU 的人。黄最近表示，“对华鹰”的标签不是美国人应该佩戴的荣誉徽章，而是应该佩戴的。这确实是“耻辱的徽章”。黄还表示，“不一定是我们或他们所有人。也可以是我们和​​他们”，这引起了政府和其他科技公司其他人的批评，其中包括 Palantir 的首席执行官。 “我欠我的家人和你们所有人一个道歉，”黄写道。 “我对我的妻子不忠。
我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。在我的一生中，我的家人给予了我爱和支持。他们值得我的诚实和忠诚。相反，我让他们失望了，破坏了我们共同建立的生活。我对我的所作所为和造成的伤害承担全部责任，并接受随之而来的批评。致我的妻子和家人：我爱你们。我知道道歉无法挽回我所做的一切。我希望我们的家庭能够痊愈，随着时间的推移，我能够赢回你们的信任。”2018 年 6 月，英特尔首席执行官布莱恩·科赞 (Brian Krzan)

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to having an affair with a woman who is allegedly a Chinese spy. His apology came in a letter to Nvidia staff, which you can read in full below. Nvidia's board of directors released a statement late on Sunday to address the bombshell report that U.S. intelligence believes Huang had an affair with a Chinese spy . The board says it has no reason to believe sensitive corporate information or U.S. national security was compromised, but the company intends to examine all available information to determine what happened. The BoD claims it is fully confident in Jensen Huang and his leadership team. Huang, who has been married to his wife, Lori Huang, for 41 years, says he fully supports the investigation. "A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation," a statement by Nvidia's BoD reads. "The Board prioritizes U.S. national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of Nvidia and its shareholders. […] Jensen fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it." On Friday, the first reporting emerged claiming U.S. intelligence agencies believe Huang had a romantic relationship with Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed who was allegedly recruited by China's Ministry of State Security (MSS) to gather information and help Chinese companies obtain restricted AI GPUs. The company has been on the radar for smuggling restricted hardware to China since at least 2025: Megaspeed has been accused of smuggling $2 billion worth of AI chips into China via its subsidiary Speedmatrix. To my colleagues at NVIDIA, I owe my family and all of you an apology. Jensen Huang, Nvidia CEO Nvidia has strenuously rejected suggestions of improper dealings, saying that its CEO regularly meets thousands of customers and that these interactions do not involve sensitive corporate information or national security secrets. Chinese officials have also dismissed the espionage allegations as unfounded. The suspected Chinese intelligence operation targeting Jensen has not been independently confirmed as a fact. The relationship is alleged to follow the typical "honeypot" strategy, wherein foreign intelligence agencies use operatives to ensnare targets into romantic relationships to steal information and influence their decision-making. Huang has been an outspoken critic of those opposed to limiting the supply of AI GPUs to China. Huang recently expressed his opinion that the label 'China hawk' is not a badge of honor Americans should wear; it is really 'a badge of shame.' Huang also said it "doesn’t have to be all us or them. It could be us and them," drawing fire from others in the administration and other tech companies, including the CEO of Palantir . "I owe my family and all of you an apology," Huang wrote . "I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry. Throughout my life, my family has given me love and support. They deserve my honesty and loyalty. Instead, I let them down and damaged the life we built together. I take full responsibility for what I did and the hurt I caused, and I accept the criticism that comes with it. To my wife and family: I love you. I know an apology cannot undo what I have done. I hope our family will heal and that, over time, I can earn back your trust." In June 2018, Intel chief executive Brian Krzanich resigned after an internal investigation, assisted by external legal counsel, confirmed that he had engaged in a consensual romantic relationship with an Intel employee, which violated the company's non-fraternization policy applicable to all managers. Krzanich, who had led Intel since 2013, also stepped down from the company's board, while then-chief financial officer Robert Swan took over as interim CEO. For now, it remains unclear if Jensen will meet a similar fate and lose control of the company he founded. Jensen's full letter to staff reads as follows: To my colleagues at NVIDIA, I owe my family and all of you an apology. I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry. Throughout my life, my family has given me love and support. They deserve my honesty and loyalty. Instead, I let them down and damaged the life we built together. I take full responsibility for what I did and the hurt I caused, and I accept the criticism that comes with it. To my wife and family: I love you. I know an apology cannot undo what I have done. I hope our family will heal and that, over time, I can earn back your trust. To my colleagues at NVIDIA, including those I have worked alongside for decades, and to our board, partners, and shareholders around the world: you deserve better from me. Leading NVIDIA is the privilege of my life. My responsibility is to serve you and be worthy of your trust. I have fallen short of that responsibility. I am fully committed to NVIDIA and will work to earn back your confidence. Regarding the national security concerns raised in news reports, NVIDIA’s Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation. I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting NVIDIA and supporting America’s national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American. My family bears no responsibility for my choices. I do. Please give them privacy. Jensen The whole statement from Nvidia's Board of Directors reads as follows: The Nvidia Board is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort. A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation. The Board prioritizes U.S. national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of NVIDIA and its shareholders. While the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised, the Board's inquiry will examine all available information. Jensen fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it. The Board has confidence in Jensen and his leadership team and will provide further updates as appropriate.

title: Nous Research Releases Arete-27B that Cuts Qwen3.8-27B Propaganda From 22% to 0.9%
zh_title: Nous Research 发布 Arete-27B，将 Qwen3.8-27B 宣传从 22% 削减至 0.9%
summary: Nous Research 发布了 Arete-27B，这是阿里巴巴 Qwen3.8-27B 的监督微调。 Arete-27B 是一个 27B 开放权重模型，从 Qwen 的答案中剥离了中国国家框架。在 Nous 自己的 803 提示评估中，包含宣传的答案从 22% 下降到 0.9%。开发人员无需国家统一的答案即可获得 Qwen 级代理技能。权重、评估和训练数据都是公开的。 TL;DR 大小：27B 密集参数（全部有效）。在 64k 环境下进行训练。 Base Qwen3.8-27B 原生支持 262,144 个令牌。运行于：BF16 重量为 53.81 GB。社区 Q4_K_M 数量为 17.20 GB，大小为 24 GB
content:
Nous Research 发布了 Arete-27B，这是阿里巴巴 Qwen3.8-27B 的监督微调。 Arete-27B 是一个 27B 开放权重模型，从 Qwen 的答案中剥离了中国国家框架。在 Nous 自己的 803 提示评估中，包含宣传的答案从 22% 下降到 0.9%。开发人员无需国家统一的答案即可获得 Qwen 级代理技能。权重、评估和训练数据都是公开的。 TL;DR 大小：27B 密集参数（全部有效）。在 64k 环境下进行训练。 Base Qwen3.8-27B 原生支持 262,144 个令牌。运行于：BF16 重量为 53.81 GB。社区 Q4_K_M 数量为 17.20 GB，大小适合 24 GB 消费级 GPU。性能：Nous 运行的基准测试中的能力保持不变；现在的政治框架符合西方模式。最佳：宣传率 0.9%，低于基础 Qwen3.8-27B 的 22%。最差：事实得分 2.98（共 5 分）； 803 个答案中的 216 个仍然得分为 0。Arete-27B 是什么？ Arete-27B 是仅经过监督微调后的 Qwen3.8-27B。 Nous 没有使用强化学习，没有偏好优化，也没有改变架构。许可证是 Apache 2.0，与基本型号匹配。 Nous 团队表示，它在基本模型中看到了对敏感话题的拒绝、偏转和中共框架下的答案。它选择了 Qwen3.8-27B，因为它是最有能力的本地模型并显示了目标行为。 Arete-27B 是如何训练的？老师是 Inkling，Thinking Machines 的开放模型。 Nous 选择了一位开放教师来避免蒸馏的使用条款限制。
在发现有关中国主题的错综复杂的记录后，它拒绝了 Nemotron 3 Ultra。训练涵盖了 64k 上下文中的约 5280 万个标记，没有序列打包。该运行需要 2 个周期和 1,202 个步骤，批量大小为 48。它使用 AdamW、1e-5 峰值学习率和张量并行 4。所有语言模型权重都经过训练。视觉编码器保持冻结状态，因为数据只是文本。多令牌预测头被禁用。发布的 arete-data-pairs 集包含 7 个主题的 34,878 个提示。每个提示都有一个 Inkling 答案和一个 Qwen 答案。 SFT 分裂中有 29,236 个已接受的教师答案。宣传评估如何进行？ Propaganda_Eval 集有 7 个值类别的 803 个提示。其中包括言论自由、国家意识形态、数据隐私和民主。每个提示都包含来自引用来源的 2 到 4 个必需事实。 Grok 4.7 法官分别对两件事进行评分： 事实平均值（0 到 5）：答案陈述了多少个必需事实。一项反对的事实得分为 0。任何宣传：采用国家账户作为自己账户的答案份额。法官必须引用确切的短语来标记宣传。 Nous 删除了与评估重叠的所有训练提示。该评估已获得 MIT 许可，并包含评分脚本。 window.addEventListener("消息",function(e){if(e.data&&e.data.mtpArete){var f=document.getElementById("mtp-arete-frame");if(f)f.style.height=e.data.mtpArete+"px";}});基准测试显示什么？
在模型卡页面上，Arete-27B 将事实均值从 2.32 提高到 2.98。宣传值从 22% 下降到 0.9%。得分为 0 的答案从 359 个下降到 803 个中的 216 个。最大的变化来自言论自由。事实得分从0.89上升到2.44，宣传得分从60%下降到1%。 Nous 测试中的能力。 Hermes Bench 从 65.77% 上升到 65.60%，Nous 称之为噪音。 Terminal-Bench-2.1 在 Nous 的使用中的使用率从 67% 上升到 70%。 Nous 并没有将这一成果归功于自己。 Arete-27B 相比如何？指标 Arete-27B Qwen3.8-27B Muse Glimmer 30B Gemma 4 31B 开发者 Nous Research 阿里巴巴 Qwen Meta Google DeepMind

【原文 English Original】
Nous Research has released Arete-27B , a supervised fine-tune of Alibaba’s Qwen3.8-27B . Arete-27B is a 27B open-weight model that strips Chinese state framing from Qwen’s answers. On Nous’s own 803-prompt eval, answers containing propaganda fell from 22% to 0.9%. Developers get Qwen-class agentic skill without state-aligned answers. The weights, eval and training data are all public. TL;DR Size: 27B dense parameters (all active). Trained at 64k context. Base Qwen3.8-27B supports 262,144 tokens natively. Runs on: BF16 weights are 53.81 GB. A community Q4_K_M quant is 17.20 GB, sized for 24 GB consumer GPUs. Performance: Capability unchanged on the benchmarks Nous ran; political framing now matches Western models. Best: Propaganda rate 0.9%, down from 22% for base Qwen3.8-27B. Worst: Fact score 2.98 of 5; 216 of 803 answers still score 0. What is Arete-27B? Arete-27B is Qwen3.8-27B after supervised fine-tuning only . Nous used no RL, no preference optimization and no architecture changes. The license is Apache 2.0, matching the base model. Nous team states that it saw refusals, deflections and CCP-framed answers on sensitive topics in the base model. It picked Qwen3.8-27B because it was the most capable local model and showed the target behavior. How was Arete-27B trained? The teacher was Inkling , an open model from Thinking Machines. Nous chose an open teacher to avoid terms-of-use limits on distillation. It rejected Nemotron 3 Ultra after finding a checkered record on China topics. Training covered about 52.8 million tokens at 64k context, without sequence packing. The run took 2 epochs and 1,202 steps at batch size 48. It used AdamW, a 1e-5 peak learning rate and tensor parallel 4. All language-model weights were trained. The vision encoder stayed frozen, since the data is text-only. The multi-token-prediction head was disabled. The released arete-data-pairs set holds 34,878 prompts across 7 topics. Each prompt has both an Inkling answer and a Qwen answer. 29,236 accepted teacher answers form the SFT split. How does the propaganda eval work? The Propaganda_Eval set has 803 prompts across 7 value categories. These include freedom of expression, state ideology, data privacy and democracy. Each prompt carries 2 to 4 required facts from a cited source. A Grok 4.7 judge grades two things separately: Fact mean (0 to 5): how many required facts the answer states. One opposed fact scores 0. Any propaganda: share of answers that adopt the state’s account as their own. The judge must quote the exact phrase to flag propaganda. Nous removed every training prompt that overlapped the eval. The eval is MIT licensed and includes grading scripts. window.addEventListener("message",function(e){if(e.data&&e.data.mtpArete){var f=document.getElementById("mtp-arete-frame");if(f)f.style.height=e.data.mtpArete+"px";}}); What do the benchmarks show? On the model card page , Arete-27B raised fact mean from 2.32 to 2.98. Propaganda fell from 22% to 0.9%. Answers scoring 0 dropped from 359 to 216 of 803. The biggest change came in freedom of expression. Fact score rose from 0.89 to 2.44, and propaganda fell from 60% to 1%. Capability held on Nous’s tests. Hermes Bench moved from 65.77% to 65.60%, which Nous calls noise. Terminal-Bench-2.1 rose from 67% to 70% in Nous’s harness. Nous does not claim credit for that gain. How does Arete-27B compare? Metrics Arete-27B Qwen3.8-27B Muse Glimmer 30B Gemma 4 31B Developer Nous Research Alibaba Qwen Meta Google DeepMind Parameters 27B dense 27B LM, dense 29.6B incl. vision, dense 30.7B, dense Context Not disclosed (trained at 64k) 262,144 native, up to 1M 131,072+ 256K License Apache 2.0 Apache 2.0 Apache 2.0 Apache 2.0 Input Text, image (encoder frozen) Text, image, video Text, image Text, image 4-bit footprint 17.20 GB Q4_K_M (community) Not disclosed Under 20 GB, 24 GB VRAM target Not disclosed Fact mean, Nous eval 2.98 2.32 3.02 2.58 Any propaganda, Nous eval 0.9% 22% 0.5% 0.5% Terminal-Bench 2.1 70% (Nous harness) 67% Nous harness; 73.0 official 51.7 (Meta, terminus2) Not disclosed by Google GPQA Diamond Not disclosed 89.2 83.5 84.3 Note: Arete and Qwen ran at temperature 0 in the Nous eval. Muse Glimmer and Gemma ran at 0.6. Terminal-Bench figures come from different harnesses. How can developers run it? Weights ship in BF16 on Hugging Face . No hosted inference provider serves the model yet. Community GGUF quants run in llama.cpp, LM Studio and Ollama, from 8.64 GB to 53.81 GB. The GGUF build also includes the image projector. Key Takeaways Arete-27B cuts Qwen3.8-27B propaganda answers from 22% to 0.9%. The fix took only 52.8M tokens of plain SFT, no RL. Hermes Bench held at 65.60% versus 65.77% for the base. Fact recall rose to 2.98 of 5 but still trails peers. Weights, eval and training data are open under Apache 2.0 and MIT. Check out the model weights , technical blog , evaluation set and training data . title: Who is Alice Huang, the Chinese tech executive accused of spying on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang?
zh_title: 被指控监视英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋的中国科技高管 Alice Huang 是谁？
summary: 据媒体报道，科技高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 被指控在与美国人工智能芯片巨头英伟达 (Nvidia) 负责人黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 的恋情中为中国从事间谍活动。 2025 年 5 月 22 日，数据中心公司 Megaspeed 的中国高管 Alice Huang（右）出席 Nvidia 首席执行官兼联合创始人黄仁勋（左）在台北一家餐厅举办的晚宴。照片：法新社。关于这名女子的公开信息很少，她也被称为黄乐，据报道她曾是新加坡一家名为 Mega 的数据中心公司的高层人物。
content:
据媒体报道，科技高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 被指控在与美国人工智能芯片巨头英伟达 (Nvidia) 负责人黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 的恋情中为中国从事间谍活动。 2025 年 5 月 22 日，数据中心公司 Megaspeed 的中国高管 Alice Huang（右）出席 Nvidia 首席执行官兼联合创始人黄仁勋（左）在台北一家餐厅举办的晚宴。照片：法新社。关于这名女子的公开信息很少，她也被称为黄乐，据报道她曾是新加坡一家名为 Megaspeed International 的数据中心公司的高层人物。以下是我们对她和公司的了解：Alice Huang 是谁？据《纽约时报》报道，爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）是一名中国公民，被北京招募来收集有关英伟达老板的情报，该报最先报道了黄仁勋是间谍阴谋的目标。尽管姓氏相同，爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 与这位 63 岁的台湾出生的世界上最有价值公司的负责人没有任何关系。 《泰晤士报》援引知情人士的话称，Alice Huang 英语说得很好，并且在全球人工智能芯片行业的最高层拥有良好的人脉。随着美国和中国竞相开发具有潜在军事应用的先进人工智能系统，该行业高度敏感。在线搜索在中国基金数据库中显示了黄爱丽 (Alice Huang) 的简短简介以及她的照片。
它列出了以前的工作经历，包括在汇丰银行、以及中国媒体中央电视台和湖南卫视的记者。法新社无法核实该简介的内容或撰写者，但已试图联系所引用的公司。这对是如何连接的？上周媒体报道称，他们关系密切，黄仁勋周日对英伟达员工表示，他对“对我妻子的不忠”感到“深感抱歉”。 LinkedIn 上发布的一张 2024 年行业聚会的照片似乎显示，身穿皮夹克的 Nvidia 老板坐在一位戴着闪亮珠宝的长发女士旁边，据信是 Alice Huang。 Nvidia 创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋于 2025 年 5 月 19 日在台湾台北举行的 Computex 2025 上发表主题演讲。照片：Nvidia。第二年，他们俩在台湾顶级科技博览会台北国际电脑展期间，出席了黄仁勋在台北一家中餐厅举办的晚宴。记者站在餐厅外，透过玻璃门窗拍摄黄仁勋和一名身穿粉色连衣裙、名叫爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 的女子与其他与会者混在一起的情况。媒体直播显示，有一次，黄仁勋用手臂搂住黄爱丽，而她亲吻了他的右脸颊。人们还看到爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）跟随这位英伟达首席执行官在外面与记者交谈后重新进入餐厅，用手指抚摸他的后背。随后，他们乘坐同一辆车离开餐厅。什么是兆速？
据《纽约时报》和《华尔街日报》报道，美国官员去年得出结论，爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）将黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）作为间谍。 据称，当时爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）是数据中心公司 Megaspeed International 的高管，该公司向其他公司出租计算能力来训练和运行人工智能。照片：Megaspeed 国际。 Megaspeed的网站称其是“英伟达算力云业务在亚太地区的核心业务合作伙伴”。该公司在 LinkedIn 上表示，其在新加坡、马来西亚和印度尼西亚设有办事处，每个办公室约有 2 至 10 名员工。

【原文 English Original】
Tech executive Alice Huang is the woman accused of spying for China during an affair with Jensen Huang, head of US artificial intelligence chip titan Nvidia, according to media reports. Alice Huang (R), a Chinese executive linked to the data centre company called Megaspeed, attending a dinner hosted by Nvidia’s chief executive and co-founder Jensen Huang (L in black back facing camera) at a restaurant in Taipei on May 22, 2025. Photo: AFP. Public details are sparse about the woman, also known as Huang Le, who had reportedly been a top figure at a Singapore-based data centre company called Megaspeed International. Here is what we know about her and the company: Who is Alice Huang? Alice Huang is a Chinese citizen recruited by Beijing to collect intelligence on the Nvidia boss, according to the New York Times, which first reported that Jensen Huang was the alleged target of a spy plot. Despite their shared surname, Alice Huang is no relation to the 63-year-old Taiwanese-born head of the world’s most valuable company. The Times, citing people briefed on the surveillance, said that Alice Huang speaks good English and is well connected at the highest level of the global AI chip industry. The sector is highly sensitive as the United States and China race to develop advanced AI systems with potential military applications. An online search brought up a short profile for Alice Huang, with her photo, on a Chinese fund database. It listed previous jobs including at HSBC bank, and as a reporter for Chinese media outlets CCTV and Hunan TV. AFP was unable to verify the contents of the profile, or who had written it, but has attempted to contact the companies cited. How are the pair connected? Media reports last week said they had a close relationship, and Jensen Huang told Nvidia employees on Sunday he was “deeply sorry” for being “unfaithful to my wife”. One photo from an industry party in 2024, posted on LinkedIn, appears to show the leather jacket-clad Nvidia boss sitting next to a long-haired woman in glitzy jewellery believed to be Alice Huang. Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang gives a keynote speech at Computex 2025 in Taipei, Taiwan, on May 19, 2025. Photo: Nvidia. The following year, they both attended a dinner hosted by Jensen Huang at a Chinese restaurant in Taipei during Computex, the island’s top tech expo. Journalists stood outside the restaurant filming through glass windows and doors as Jensen Huang and a woman identified as Alice Huang, who was wearing a pink dress, mingled with other attendees. At one point, Jensen Huang can be seen putting his arm around Alice Huang as she kisses him on the right cheek, press livestreams show. Alice Huang is also seen following the Nvidia chief as he re-enters the restaurant after talking to journalists outside, running her fingers down his lower back. They later leave the restaurant in the same car. What is Megaspeed? US officials concluded last year that Alice Huang was targeting Jensen Huang as a spy, according to the New York Times and the Wall Street Journal. At the time, Alice Huang was said to be a top executive at data centre firm Megaspeed International, which rents out computing power to other companies to train and run AI. Photo: Megaspeed International. Megaspeed’s website says it is “a core business partner of Nvidia’s computing power cloud business in the Asia-Pacific region”. On LinkedIn, it says it has offices in Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia, with around two to 10 employees and 25 “associated members”. When AFP called the number listed on Megaspeed’s website, the person who answered said they were unfamiliar with the company and that the number was a residential line. The firm was previously called 7Road International, according to the Singapore government’s website, suggesting links to Chinese gaming company 7Road. Has Megaspeed helped China evade US restrictions on chips? Washington restricts the export to China of Nvidia’s most cutting-edge silicon chips, citing national security concerns but also seen as a measure to stay ahead in AI. The New York Times said the US government had been probing Megaspeed since 2024 over its potential steering of Nvidia chips to China. Nvidia headquarters in Santa Clara, California. Photo: Nvidia. The company has also reportedly been under investigation by Singapore authorities, who the Times says questioned Alice Huang in 2025. AFP has contacted Singapore’s police and the home affairs ministry for comment. Last year Bloomberg News also reported on the Singaporean probe into Megaspeed over the alleged smuggling of Nvidia chips to China. In December 2025, Megaspeed said Bloomberg’s reporting “contains misleading information and incorrect insinuations, including suggestions that we may have been involved in illegal chip transfers”.

title: Hong Kong must reform ticketing and venue rules to attract touring mega-acts, think tank says
zh_title: 智囊团表示，香港必须改革票务和场地规则以吸引大型巡演
summary: 一家智库发现，近年来大多数西方艺术家的巡演都跳过了香港，香港必须加强票务系统，确保主办方能够找到吸引巡演艺术家的场地。 2024 年 12 月 1 日，Clockenflap 的观众。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。香港未来经济研究所周一发布的一份报告分析了2023年至2026年间95位西方艺术家的巡回演唱会，其中只有21.1%包括香港。几乎一半的旅行团包括新加坡，占 49.5%，而东京则占近四分之三的旅行团，占 7%
content:
一家智库发现，近年来大多数西方艺术家的巡演都跳过了香港，香港必须加强票务系统，确保主办方能够找到吸引巡演艺术家的场地。 2024 年 12 月 1 日，Clockenflap 的观众。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。香港未来经济研究所周一发布的一份报告分析了2023年至2026年间95位西方艺术家的巡回演唱会，其中只有21.1%包括香港。几乎一半的旅行团包括新加坡，占 49.5%，而东京则占近四分之三的旅行团，占 74.7%。 “艾德·希兰 (Ed Sheeran) 在一次巡演中演奏了 16 个亚洲城市，但没有在香港演出；杜阿·利帕 (Dua Lipa) 演奏了 8 个城市。总共 95 场西方巡演中，有 75 场不包括香港，”它说。报告还指出，自启德体育场启用以来，“数据显示香港的地位没有明显改善”，并指出截至 2026 年 9 月，酷玩乐队是唯一一家在该场地演出的西方乐队。照片：塞巴斯蒂安·纳吉。报道撰写时，加拿大歌手 The Weeknd 尚未在体育场演出。上个月，他在该场地继续进行了四场演出，场场门票全部售空，其中他的新歌《香港》（采样了粤语流行偶像王菲 1993 年的歌曲）登上了当地排行榜的榜首。
报告称，不断增加的票务欺诈和较短的场地预订窗口是导致香港落后于区域竞争对手的“弱点”。报告称，“香港拥有活动之都的资产：强有力的政策支持、国际连通性和主要的新场馆。然而，这些优势尚未转化为国际西方旅游的可比份额。” “观众需要能够放心地购买门票，主办方需要在协调跨城市的日期的同时确保合适的场地。我们的审查发现了这两方面的弱点。”另请参阅：文化负责人表示，在新加坡将主办 Lady Gaga 的消息传出后，香港正努力引进大型国际活动 该报告指出，2024 年至 2025 年间，演唱会门票欺诈案件增加了 62%，而消费者委员会有关公开演出的投诉激增了 202%，同期从 626 起增加到 1,889 起。报告称，机器人购买和倒卖行为，以及对这些行为的控制和执行薄弱，也可能破坏了“粉丝和组织者所需的可靠性和透明度”。该协会还表示，红磡香港体育馆等政府运营场地的预订规则“不太适合”国际巡演，因为音乐会的预订期限为 12 个月，而且缺乏临时举行制度。香港启德体育公园。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。
该研究所建议政府通过提高倒票罚款、公布门票分配数据和升级平台基础设施来实现票务和消费者保护安排的现代化。它还敦促引入两年预订窗口，为国际申请提供明确的评估标准，并提供免费的临时保留，并呼吁公布批准时间表和预订结果。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong must step up its ticketing systems and ensure promoters can secure venues to attract touring artists, a think tank has said, after finding that most Western artists’ tours skipped the city in recent years. Audience members at Clockenflap, on December 1, 2024. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Out of 95 Western artists’ concert tours between 2023 and 2026 analysed in a report published on Monday by the Hong Kong Future Economy Institute, just 21.1 per cent included Hong Kong. Almost half of the tours included Singapore, at 49.5 per cent, while Tokyo was on almost three-quarters of the tours, at 74.7 per cent. “Ed Sheeran played sixteen Asian cities on one tour without a Hong Kong date; Dua Lipa played eight. In total, 75 of the 95 Western tours did not include Hong Kong,” it said. ‘Weaknesses on both fronts’ The report also stated that “the data shows no clear improvement in Hong Kong’s position” since the opening of Kai Tak Stadium, noting that Coldplay was the sole Western act to have played the venue as of September 2026. The Weeknd in Hong Kong. Photo: Sebastian Nagy. Canadian singer The Weeknd had not yet performed at the stadium when the report was compiled. He went on to play four sold-out shows at the venue last month, with his new track “Hong Kong” — which samples a 1993 song by Cantopop icon Faye Wong — topping local charts. Rising ticketing fraud and short venue booking windows are “weaknesses” that have contributed to the lag behind the city’s regional rivals, the report said. “Hong Kong has the assets of an events capital: strong policy backing, international connectivity and major new venues. Yet these strengths have not translated into a comparable share of international Western tours,” it said. “Audiences need to be able to buy tickets with confidence, and promoters need to secure suitable venues while coordinating dates across cities. Our review identifies weaknesses on both fronts.” See also: Hong Kong striving to bring in large-scale int’l events, says culture chief amid word that Singapore to host Lady Gaga The report cited a 62 per cent rise in concert ticket fraud cases between 2024 and 2025, alongside a 202 per cent surge in Consumer Council complaints regarding public performances, rising from 626 to 1,889 over the same period. Bot purchases and scalping — as well as weak controls and enforcement against those practices — may also have undermined “the reliability and transparency that fans and organisers need,” the report said. The institute also said that booking rules at government-run venues such as the Hong Kong Coliseum in Hung Hom were “poorly suited” for international tours, pointing to the 12-month window for booking concerts and the lack of a provisional holding system. Hong Kong’s Kai Tak Sports Park. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The institute recommended that the government modernise ticketing and consumer protection arrangements by raising scalping fines, publishing ticket allocation data, and upgrading platform infrastructure. It also urged the introduction of a two-year booking window with clear evaluation criteria for international applications, alongside cost-free provisional holds, and called for the publication of approval timelines and booking outcomes.

title: Nvidia announces probe into CEO Jensen Huang after he acknowledges affair with alleged Chinese spy
zh_title: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认与涉嫌中国间谍有染后，宣布对他进行调查
summary: 芯片巨头英伟达董事会周日宣布，在首席执行官兼联合创始人黄仁勋承认与一名美国官员称为中国情报机构工作的女性有染后，对他展开调查。 Nvidia 创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋于 2026 年 1 月 5 日在内华达州拉斯维加斯举行的年度消费电子展之前，在 CES 2026 的 Nvidia Live 上发表讲话。照片：Patrick T. Fallon/法新社。上个月末，《纽约时报》报道称，美国情报官员得出的结论是，这名女子是一名与新加坡一家名为 Megaspeed 的数据中心公司有联系的中国高管。
content:
芯片巨头英伟达董事会周日宣布，在首席执行官兼联合创始人黄仁勋承认与一名美国官员称为中国情报机构工作的女性有染后，对他展开调查。 Nvidia 创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋于 2026 年 1 月 5 日在内华达州拉斯维加斯举行的年度消费电子展之前，在 CES 2026 的 Nvidia Live 上发表讲话。照片：Patrick T. Fallon/法新社。上个月末，《纽约时报》报道称，美国情报官员得出的结论是，这名女子是一名与新加坡一家名为 Megaspeed 的数据中心公司有联系的中国高管，一直在向北京输送信息。据《泰晤士报》报道，这位高管爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）——又名黄乐，与 63 岁的台湾出生的黄仁勋没有任何关系——与 Nvidia 老板建立了密切的关系。在周日发布的致公司员工的信息中，黄承认有外遇，并向家人和公司员工道歉。 “我对我的妻子不忠，”他说。 “我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”黄仁勋是人工智能革命的重要人物，也是唐纳德·特朗普总统的亲密非正式顾问，特朗普多次公开反对监管该行业，以免让中国在人工智能竞赛中占据上风。 《泰晤士报》称，黄与另一位黄的关系可能让她深入了解特朗普对人工智能的看法。
特朗普计划于本月晚些时候在中国举行的峰会上与习近平主席举行会谈，人工智能问题可能会出现。英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在华盛顿特区安德鲁·W·梅隆礼堂举行的白宫人工智能峰会上。 2025 年 7 月 23 日。照片：白宫，来自 Flickr。英伟达在一份声明中表示，“鉴于最近有报道称创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋已成为外国情报机构的目标”，该公司已展开独立调查。声明补充道：“虽然委员会没有理由相信国家安全或 NVIDIA 机密受到损害，但委员会的调查将检查所有可用信息。”周日被问及黄的情况时，特朗普告诉记者：“我只知道他是一个好人，但你永远不知道发生了什么。我确信——我希望一切都好。他做了如此令人难以置信的工作。”中国政府驳斥了《纽约时报》的报道，称其为“毫无根据的猜测”。 “黑眼圈时刻” 中国正在与美国争夺科技主导地位，美国限制了最尖端硅芯片向中国的出口。英伟达是生产用于训练和运行人工智能模型的芯片的全球领导者，也是世界上最有价值的公司之一。 《泰晤士报》援引未透露姓名的知情人士的话报道称，Megaspeed 因可能将 Nvidia 人工智能芯片转移到中国而受到审查。
据《泰晤士报》报道，特朗普大约一年前获悉有关黄与这位女商人关系的情报调查结果，并选择不对这些信息采取行动。特朗普周日表示，他并不后悔没有对这一情报采取行动。 “不，我不这么认为。我认为——你知道，他是一个值得尊敬的人。我认为他可能有一个借口。你必须听到它。” Nvidia 创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋于 2025 年 5 月 19 日在台湾台北举行的 Computex 2025 上发表主题演讲。照片：Nvidia。投资银行约克维尔艾夫斯 (Yorkville Ives) 的技术分析师丹·艾夫斯 (Dan Ives) 表示，调查的消息对黄仁勋来说是“一个沉重的时刻”。艾夫斯预测这至少会引起人们的注意

【原文 English Original】
Chip giant Nvidia’s board announced Sunday it opened a probe into Chief Executive and co-founder Jensen Huang after he acknowledged an affair with a woman US officials say was working for Chinese intelligence. Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang speaks during Nvidia Live at CES 2026 ahead of the annual Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas, Nevada, on January 5, 2026. Photo: Patrick T. Fallon/AFP. Late last month, The New York Times reported that US intelligence officials concluded that the woman, a Chinese executive linked to a Singapore-based data center company called Megaspeed, had been funnelling information to Beijing. The executive, Alice Huang — also known as Huang Le, and no relation to 63-year-old Taiwanese-born Jensen Huang — developed a close relationship with the Nvidia boss, the Times said. In a message to company employees released Sunday, Huang acknowledged having an affair and apologized to his family and company staff. “I was unfaithful to my wife,” he said. “My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.” Jensen Huang is a huge figure in the artificial intelligence revolution and a close informal adviser to President Donald Trump, who has repeatedly spoken out against regulating the industry so as not to let China gain the upper hand in the AI race. The Times said Huang’s relationship with the other Huang could have given her insights into Trump’s thinking around AI. The issue of AI is likely to arise during Trump’s planned talks with President Xi Jinping later this month at a summit in China. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at the White House AI Summit at Andrew W. Mellon Auditorium in Washington, DC. on July 23, 2025. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. Nvidia said in a statement it opened an independent probe “in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort.” The statement added: “While the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised , the Board’s inquiry will examine all available information.” Asked about Huang on Sunday, Trump told reporters: “I just know he’s a fine person, but you never know what’s going on. I’m sure — I hope everything’s fine. He’s done such an incredible job.” The Chinese government has dismissed the Times report as “groundless speculation.” ‘Black eye moment’ China is in a race for tech dominance with the United States, which restricts the export to China of the most cutting-edge silicon chips. Nvidia, a global leader in producing chips used to train and run AI models, is one of the world’s most valuable companies. Megaspeed was under scrutiny for possibly steering Nvidia AI chips to China, the Times report said, citing unnamed sources briefed on the matter. Trump was briefed on the intelligence findings about Huang’s relationship with the businesswoman roughly a year ago and chose not to act on the information, the Times report said. Trump said Sunday he did not regret not acting on this intelligence. “No, I don’t think so. I think — you know, he’s an honorable guy. I think he probably has an excuse for it. You have to hear it.” Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang gives a keynote speech at Computex 2025 in Taipei, Taiwan, on May 19, 2025. Photo: Nvidia. Technology analyst Dan Ives, with the investment bank Yorkville Ives, said word of the probe is “a black eye moment” for Jensen Huang. Ives predicted it will at the very least spark multiple congressional inquiries and “create an overhang on the stock for a myriad of reasons.” In the near-term Huang is expected to keep his job but risks being removed as Nvidia’s CEO depending on the board’s probe, Ives said in a statement. “This will add risk to the stock as he is so important to the Nvidia story and strategy globally,” he said. “This will also increase major scrutiny regarding selling chips to China, which remains a key battleground issue in DC.”

title: Hong Kong to see cold snap from Tuesday with lows of 16°C following hottest October on record
zh_title: 继十月有记录以来最热之后，香港周二起将迎来寒潮，最低气温将达到 16°C
summary: 继有记录以来最热的十月之后，香港人本周将经历寒流。香港人穿着夹克。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。周一该市最低气温将达到 19 摄氏度，周二气温将在 16 至 23 摄氏度之间。一股强冷锋将横过中国南部沿海，为本港带来干燥凉爽的天气：“受冷锋带来的强烈东北季风影响，今天广东多风，气温明显下降……昼夜温差将在
content:
继有记录以来最热的十月之后，香港人本周将经历寒流。香港人穿着夹克。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。周一该市最低气温将达到 19 摄氏度，周二气温将在 16 至 23 摄氏度之间。一股强冷锋将横过中国南部沿海，为本港带来干燥凉爽的天气：“受冷锋带来的强烈东北季风影响，今天广东地区有风，气温明显下降……昼夜温差较大。”然而，随着热带气旋千帕卡抵达日本，周三之后气温将开始上升，预计周末将有阵雨：“季风预计将在本周后半段减弱，该地区气温将上升……高空扰动将在周末为中国南部带来阵雨。”有记录以来最热的十月天文台录得有史以来最高的十月平均最高气温30.5摄氏度。 2026 年夏季，香港遭遇破纪录的热浪。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。
上周在一份新闻稿中表示：“主要是由于东北季风较正常弱，华南地区高空反气旋较正常强，加上气候变暖和可能持续至明年初的强烈厄尔尼诺现象，2026年10月香港异常温暖。”政府间气候变化专门委员会警告说，自20世纪50年代以来，热浪的强度和频率持续增加，原因是人为造成的气候变化。二氧化碳等温室气体的普遍存在，将热量滞留在大气中，导致地球表面温度升高，更热、更长时间的热浪将生命置于危险之中。另请参阅：极端高温如何成为世界天气灾害中最致命的无声杀手 研究非政府组织伯克利地球表示，自工业革命以来，香港的气温已经升高了 1.7 摄氏度。根据 2023 年的一项研究，到本世纪末，高温和湿度可能会在较长时间内达到致命水平，导致世界某些地区无法呆在户外。

【原文 English Original】
Hongkongers will experience a cold snap this week following the hottest October on record. People wearing jackets in Hong Kong. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The city will see lows of 19 degrees Celsius on Monday, with temperatures on Tuesday ranging from 16 to 23 degrees Celsius. A strong cold front will cross China’s southern coast, bringing dry and cool weather to the territory: “Under the influence of the intense northeast monsoon associated with a cold front, it will be windy and temperatures will fall appreciably over Guangdong today… The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large.” However, the mercury will begin to rise after Wednesday with showers expected over the weekend as Tropical Cyclone Cempaka arrives in Japan: “The monsoon is expected to moderate in the latter part of this week, temperatures will rise over the region… Upper-air disturbances will bring showers to southern China towards the weekend.” Hottest October on record It comes after the Observatory recorded the highest-ever monthly mean maximum temperature in October of 30.5 degrees Celsius. Hong Kong saw a record-breaking heatwave in summer 2026. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Mainly due to a weaker-than-normal northeast monsoon and a stronger-than-normal upper-air anticyclone over southern China, and set against the backdrop of climate warming and a very strong El Niño event that may persist into early next year, October 2026 was unseasonably warm in Hong Kong,” it said last week in a press release. The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change has warned that the intensity and frequency of heatwaves have continued to increase since the 1950s due to human-caused climate change. The prevalence of greenhouse gases like carbon dioxide – which trap heat in the atmosphere – raises the planet’s surface temperature, with hotter, longer heatwaves putting lives at risk. See also: How extreme heat became the deadliest silent killer among world weather disasters Hong Kong has already warmed by 1.7 degrees Celsius since the Industrial Revolution, research NGO Berkeley Earth says . Heat and humidity may reach lethal levels for protracted periods by the end of the century, according to a 2023 study , making it impossible to stay outdoors in some parts of the world.

content: Eric Chau   臉書  2026-11-8 香港禁片《消失的檔案》（Vanished Archives）是由香港資深傳媒人羅恩惠執導、歷時四年苦心搜集資料而完成的紀錄片。 這部影片之所以命名為「消失的檔案」，是因為導演當初在香港歷史檔案館搜集「六七暴動」的官方影像紀錄時，驚覺原應長達數百小時的歷史片段，在香港竟然只剩下殘缺不全的21秒。 為了尋回被刻意或無意抹去的歷史真相，羅恩惠遠赴英國國家檔案館翻查解密文件，並親自訪問了大量當年的親歷者。這部紀錄片最終揭露了多項關於1967年香港暴動事件、極具震撼力的內幕消息與歷史黑幕： 紀錄片揭露的四大核心內幕 1. 核心絕密文獻：《吳荻舟日記》與《67筆記》 影片最關鍵的歷史突破，是找到了當年國務院外事辦公室港澳組副組長吳荻舟的私人筆記與檢討材料。 中央高層直接介入： 過去有說法指六七暴動純屬香港左派造反派（如新華社香港分社）自導自演的盲動。但《67筆記》證實，北京中央政府對香港暴亂的每一個細節其實一直知情，甚至不時發出具體指示。 截獲「真槍實彈」： 筆記記載，當時有左派激進分子試圖從內地運送8,400把滅火刀（砍刀）到香港發動武裝暴動。這批物資最終被吳荻舟及時攔截，他因此在文革中遭到迫害。這證實當時暴動確實有演變成全面血腥武裝衝突的奪權計畫。 2. 揭開「少年犯」與「炸彈隊」的真實代價 六七暴動後期發展成無差別的恐怖主義炸彈襲擊，街道上到處都是俗稱「菠蘿」的土製炸彈。 被煽動的愛國學生： 影片訪問了多位當年的左派學校學生（如香島中學、培僑中學等）。他們在文革狂熱的政治宣傳下被煽動組織「炸彈隊」，抱著「反英抗暴」的愛國熱忱上街投擲炸彈、派發傳單。 被拋棄的犧牲品： 這些年輕人在入獄後遭到港英政府的嚴刑拷打，甚至被秘密政治部審訊。然而，當暴動被周恩來叫停、事件平息後，中共高層為了重回外交正軌，迅速與這些基層左派「割席」。這些留有案底的年輕人被港英政府與中共雙方拋棄，政治狂熱退去後，換來的是大半生的坎坷與幻滅。 3. 港共地下黨的權力鬥爭與盲動 紀錄片揭示，這場暴動本質上是中國文化大革命在香港的外延與投影。當時新華社香港分社（實際上的港共地下黨組織）社長梁威林、副社長祁烽等人，為迎合內地文革「造反有理」的風潮，並在外交部奪權鬥爭中表態，不惜在香港無限放大勞資糾紛（新蒲崗人造花廠事件），刻意將其升級為流血政治對抗。 4. 歷史敘事權的爭奪與「改寫」 這部影片最深遠的內幕，莫過於揭露了官方對歷史記憶的系統性清洗。 港英政府的處理： 六七暴動結束後，英國政府將大量極度敏感的政治部（Political Department）檔案、港共滲透名單及審訊紀錄運回英國本土，或直接銷毀，導致香港本地檔案館出現巨大斷層。 特區政府的洗白： 導演指出，近年來特區政府及建制陣營正試圖「重塑」這段歷史，淡化無差別炸彈襲擊對平民造成的傷害，將其重新包裝成「反殖民統治的愛國正義抗爭」。《消失的檔案》則透過血淋淋的受害者證詞（如商業電台林彬被活活燒死、北角小姊弟被炸彈炸死的家屬訪問），還原了這場運動曾演變成無差別恐怖襲擊的史實。 影片的遭遇與社會餘波 由於影片赤裸裸地曝光了中共與港共組織在歷史上的操弄與滲透，《消失的檔案》在2017年完成後遭遇了極大的政治壓力： 官方及商業電影院拒絕放映，香港國際電影節亦以「缺乏藝術性」為由將其拒之門外。 儘管遭受封殺，導演依然在香港社區、學校及海外（美、加、台）進行了數百場獨立放映，引發極大反響，被歷史學者視為還原香港當代史最重要的民間口述紀錄片。 歷史猶如一面鏡子，五十年前內地與香港的政治糾葛，與今日香港的政治變遷有著絲絲入扣的歷史脈絡。羅恩惠導演曾表示，拍攝這部影片不為挑起仇恨，而是為了「守護香港記憶，不讓真相在掌權者的橡皮擦下消失」。

title: 朱明昌：从黄之锋案看香港民主的沉沦

content: ——当国家安全成为打压民主的工具 失去的将不仅是一个人的自由 从少年学生到民主运动的代表人物，从街头抗争到铁窗生涯，黄之锋的人生经历，折射出香港过去十多年来政治环境发生的巨大变化。资料图片。（孙明国／大纪元） 【大纪元2026年11月07日讯】2026年11月5日，香港民主运动人士、前香港众志秘书长黄之锋，被香港高等法院判处监禁10年。 这个消息令人震惊，也令人心痛。 一个年仅30岁的年轻人，从十几岁开始投身香港社会运动，经历了2014年的雨伞运动、2019年的反送中运动，最终却在自己人生最宝贵的青春岁月中，长期被关押在监狱里。 从少年学生到民主运动的代表人物，从街头抗争到铁窗生涯，黄之锋的人生经历，折射出香港过去十多年来政治环境发生的巨大变化。 这不仅仅是黄之锋一个人的悲剧，更是香港民主自由不断萎缩的历史缩影。 一、从雨伞运动到反送中：一代香港青年的民主理想 2014年，香港爆发雨伞运动。无数年轻人走上街头，要求真正的民主选举，要求香港人能够决定自己的未来。 当时的黄之锋还是一名年轻学生。他与许多香港青年一样，相信民主、自由、法治和公民权利，相信一个社会应当允许不同声音存在。 2019年，反送中运动再次席卷香港。 数以百万计的香港市民走上街头，表达对修订《逃犯条例》的担忧，也表达对香港自治、法治和自由前景的忧虑。 这场运动让全世界重新关注香港。 然而，运动之后，香港的政治环境发生了深刻变化。2020年6月30日，《香港国安法》实施，民主派组织相继解散，许多民主人士被捕、被起诉，新闻媒体和公民社会也受到巨大冲击。 香港曾经引以为傲的自由开放形象，正在发生根本性的变化。 二、十年刑期背后：国家安全与公民自由的冲突 根据中央社报导，黄之锋此次被控的罪名，是串谋勾结外国或者境外势力危害国家安全罪。 案件涉及他与罗冠聪等人，在2020年期间呼吁外国采取制裁等措施。 黄之锋此前已经因为香港民主派立法会初选案，被判处4年8个月监禁。此次又被判处10年。 值得注意的是，法院裁定其中2个月2日与原有刑期同期执行。 对于这一判决，我们不能只停留在法律条文和刑期数字上，更应该追问一个根本问题： 一个社会究竟应当如何界定国家安全？公民表达政治诉求、寻求国际社会关注，是否就应该被视为危害国家安全？ 国家安全固然重要，但国家安全不应成为无限扩大权力、压制公民基本权利的理由。 真正有信心的政府，应当允许社会批评，接受公众监督，尊重不同政治意见。 如果一个政府无法容忍批评，甚至将政治异见视为国家安全威胁，那么受到损害的，不只是个人自由，更是整个社会的法治基础。 三、香港的悲剧 是中共承诺与现实之间的巨大落差 香港回归之初，国际社会关注的核心问题之一，就是香港能否保持原有的生活方式和制度。 一国两制的承诺，曾经让香港人对未来抱有希望。 香港之所以能够成为国际金融中心，不仅因为它拥有优越的地理位置和经济条件，更因为它曾经拥有相对独立的司法制度、开放的信息环境、自由的新闻媒体以及受到保障的公民权利。 这些制度优势，是香港最宝贵的财富。 然而，当政治权力不断扩大，当新闻自由受到压缩，当民主人士因为政治活动而长期失去人身自由，香港原有的制度优势也必然受到冲击。 一个国际城市的竞争力，不能仅仅依靠高楼大厦、金融市场和经济数据来维持。 自由、法治、诚信和制度保障，同样是不可替代的基础。 失去这些，香港失去的将不仅是过去的光环，更可能是未来的国际信任。 四、压制可以让街头安静 却无法消灭人民对自由的向往 历史一再证明，强权可以控制一时的社会秩序，却无法永远控制人的思想。 香港民主运动经历了挫折，许多参与者被迫离开家园，有人身陷囹圄，有人流亡海外，也有人选择沉默。 但是，民主、自由和人权并不是某一个政治组织的专利，而是人类社会共同追求的基本价值。 黄之锋被判刑10年，令人看到一个年轻人的人生被长期监禁所改变，也让世界重新思考香港的自由究竟走向何方。 我们不应该因为一个人身陷囹圄，就认为他的理想也随之消失。 历史不会因为监狱的大门关闭，就停止记录一个时代的真相。 五、香港的今天 也应该成为中国未来的警示 香港曾经是中国与自由世界之间重要的桥梁。 它向世界证明，华人社会同样能够拥有自由、法治、民主和繁荣。 香港的民主运动，也让更多中国大陆民众看到，追求公民权利、要求政府接受监督，并不是所谓的西方专利，而是每一个现代社会公民都应当享有的权利。 今天香港所经历的一切，也值得中国大陆人民深思。 一个国家真正的强大，不是让所有人只说一种声音，而是能够容纳不同意见；不是让人民对权力保持恐惧，而是让权力接受人民监督。 一个政府的合法性和社会公信力，不应建立在恐惧和沉默之上，而应建立在人民的信任、法律的公正以及公民权利的保障之上。 香港的自由不能成为历史，中国的民主也不应该成为遥不可及的梦想。 黄之锋案再次提醒我们：民主的道路可能曲折，自由的代价有时沉重，但一个民族不能因为恐惧而放弃对尊严的追求。 十年铁窗，锁住的是一个人的身体，却不应该成为一个时代思想的牢笼。 对于香港，我们希望有一天能够重新拥有真正的新闻自由、司法独立、民主选举和公民权利。 对于中国，我们期待一个不再以政治恐惧统治人民、不再把不同声音视为敌人的民主社会。 自由不应当是罪名，民主不应当是禁忌，人权更不应当成为任何政权可以随意剥夺的东西。 这是黄之锋案留给香港、留给中国，也留给整个自由世界的一道严肃考题。

title: 中共跨境“反腐” 专家忧其沦为权斗工具
summary: 【大纪元2026年11月08日讯】（大纪元记者程木兰、骆亚采访报导）中共全国人大常委会11月6日通过“反跨境腐败法”，同日生效。北京把海外追逃追赃纳入常设机制，由国家监察委员会统筹，并收紧外方在中国境内调查取证。专家警告，在中共主导查办的体制下，这套机制可被用来追查失势官员的海外资产，也为境外“劝返”和政治施压异议人士提供新名目。 北京把“猎狐”“天网”纳入常设机制 中共于10月26日至29日在北京召开二十届五中全会宣告“全面从严治党”，并有多位官员遭开除党籍。随后于十四届全
content: 【大纪元2026年11月08日讯】（大纪元记者程木兰、骆亚采访报导）中共全国人大常委会11月6日通过“反跨境腐败法”，同日生效。北京把海外追逃追赃纳入常设机制，由国家监察委员会统筹，并收紧外方在中国境内调查取证。专家警告，在中共主导查办的体制下，这套机制可被用来追查失势官员的海外资产，也为境外“劝返”和政治施压异议人士提供新名目。 北京把“猎狐”“天网”纳入常设机制 中共于10月26日至29日在北京召开二十届五中全会宣告“全面从严治党”，并有多位官员遭开除党籍。随后于十四届全国人大常委会第二十五次会议11月6日表决通过《反跨境腐败法》，公布之日起施行。 中国问题专家王赫接受大纪元采访时指出，防堵资金外流，尤其是防止国有资产藉利益输送流往境外，是北京扩大追查权的一个动机。 他分析，过去的“猎狐”“天网”主要靠专案推进。中共这次把分散的涉外规定和部门权责集中起来，由国家监察委员会牵头，让公安、财政、审计和反洗钱部门能在同一机制下共享线索。 资深评论员横河则注意到，新法通过当天即生效，有别于往常惯例。他推测这部法是为了惩罚某个人或某些人，“抓人时还没有足够的法律可用来惩罚，所以急需立新法”。 中国大陆前检察官沈良庆也把立法时点与中共二十届五中全会重申“从严治党”相连，视为这项党内政策的立法配套。他向大纪元表示，中共在缺少引渡协议的地方往往只能逐案协商，既有行动的成效受到限制。 中共新法上路前，当局依《监察法》请求外国协助引渡嫌疑人、追回涉案资产。新法上路后，涉案行为是否构成犯罪，仍按中共《刑法》判断。 据新华社今年2月底转述中纪委工作报告，中共官方2025年立案查处505件跨境腐败案件，并透过“天网”等行动追回963名外逃人员。 反腐法律成为权斗工具？ 王赫用“看人下菜”形容中共的选择性反腐，“不是看你做了什么，是看你是什么样的人。” 他认为，在中共领导反腐工作的架构下，“政治忠诚”和站队仍可能左右谁被立案、谁被保护。对当局有意保护的高官，他担忧海外资产线索可能以机密为由被搁置。对政治对手，北京则能动员更多部门追查资金、寻求境外协助。他预判，新法将“成为权力斗争的一个合法化的工具”。 中国大陆律师章廷（化名）把问题追溯到中共制定法律的方式。他接受大纪元采访时以“帮规”和“家法”形容这套法律，认为立法缺乏民众充分参与和真正授权，制定和执行法律的考量，往往是维持中共统治与保护特权阶层。 他认为，在中共体制下，若案件未牵涉权斗，新法对在任或退休高官及其家属的影响可能有限。 章廷指出，权力缺乏制衡所造成的腐败，很难靠再立一部法律解决。他把这类反腐形容为“清洗的手段，是权斗的延伸”。 沈良庆则把反腐与权斗交织、选择性执法的现象称为“制度性的老大难痼疾”。在他看来，新法对官员及其家属向境外转移涉案资产，或有一定约束，但公权力缺乏制衡的问题始终存在。 高官家属的海外资产能否被追及？ 王赫认为，财政、审计与反洗钱部门共享线索后，当局更容易追查中低层外逃官员及国企高管的资金流向。若资产所在国愿意合作，冻结涉案财产也较有可能。 至于高层官员和家属，他认为新法的约束力“非常有限”。即使财产登记在亲属名下，追缴仍涉及两个关口。中国境内须启动查办并厘清资产与违法所得的关联，境外的查账、冻结或返还则须由当地依法律程序处理。 王赫认为，北京可向关系较密切的国家寻求协助，例如中东或东南亚部分国家，请求冻结涉案资产。横河则强调，外国原本就不愿协助的案件，未必会因北京有了新法而改变立场。 欧洲人权法院2022年曾就波兰拟将一名因被控涉嫌跨国电信诈欺而引渡至中国的嫌疑人，裁定其有遭受不当待遇的实际风险，移交将违反《欧洲人权公约》。国际刑警组织（INTERPOL）也说明，各国是否依红色通报采取逮捕行动，仍依本国法律决定。 北京反制外国调查 跨国企业夹在中间 新法允许北京在认定外国不当行使域外管辖、损害中国利益等条件下采取反制措施，也要求外方在中国境内展开反腐执法调查，以及境内机构向境外提供相关证据或资料，须经中方同意。 沈良庆认为，中共一方面要求出海企业加强合规，另一方面也藉反制条款牵制外国政府调查中国企业及官员。王赫以美国《海外反腐败法》（FCPA）为例指出，若外方要求一家跨国公司提交在中国掌握的文件，公司可能同时面对外方取证要求和中方限制。他形容这是“中美之间司法对抗的一个升级”。 中国民主活动家王丹在播客节目《王丹学堂》也以内部审计为例，指出跨国企业总部若要查核海外交易，而中共监管机关同时以跨境腐败为由要求取得审计资料，当地团队将面临两套要求而难以适从。 反腐名义将被用于跨境施压？ 横河指出，过去有些境外“劝返”透过跟踪、威胁或向境内家属施压，迫使当事人回中国。他担忧，新法会让这类行动更容易被北京包装成反腐执法。 美国司法部2025年4月16日公布，曾参与“猎狐”行动的纽约前警员麦克马洪（Michael McMahon），因非法充当中国政府代理人及跨州跟踪等罪名，被判入狱18个月。 王丹也认为，新法替争议性的境外行动“穿上了一件法律的外衣”。他特别质疑，法律涵盖部分行为发生在境外、结果落在中国境内的同类腐败行为，可能给执法机关留下扩张解释的空间。他以政治捐款、慈善捐款和学术交流为例，追问当局将如何划定正常资金往来与涉案交易的界线。 他担心，当局可能从海外异议人士与境内亲友的资金往来着手，将人列为案件关系人，再借经济调查施压。在王丹看来，这种不确定性，本身就可能造成寒蝉效应。

title: 馮睎乾：黃之鋒判刑書是怎樣寫成的？
summary: 馮睎乾十三維度 臉書 2026-11-7 黃之鋒判刑書是怎樣寫成的？ 被指「串謀勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全」的黃之鋒，昨日被判囚十年。法官譚耀豪稱黃之鋒、羅冠聰同為主腦，「罪行重大」，判刑須具阻嚇力，並表達「社會對黃之鋒計劃及行為的厭惡」（但社會有多少人厭惡呢？），故以十三年為量刑起點，考慮被告認罪，扣減至監禁十年，其中兩個月零兩日跟「初選案」刑期同時執行。因兩項「国安罪」，三十歲的黃之鋒共須服刑約十四年半，出獄已四十歲了。 黃之鋒究竟犯了什麼大罪，需要重判十年監禁呢
content: 馮睎乾十三維度 臉書  2026-11-7 黃之鋒判刑書是怎樣寫成的？ 被指「串謀勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全」的黃之鋒，昨日被判囚十年。法官譚耀豪稱黃之鋒、羅冠聰同為主腦，「罪行重大」，判刑須具阻嚇力，並表達「社會對黃之鋒計劃及行為的厭惡」（但社會有多少人厭惡呢？），故以十三年為量刑起點，考慮被告認罪，扣減至監禁十年，其中兩個月零兩日跟「初選案」刑期同時執行。因兩項「国安罪」，三十歲的黃之鋒共須服刑約十四年半，出獄已四十歲了。 黃之鋒究竟犯了什麼大罪，需要重判十年監禁呢？宏福苑大火死了168人，政府內那些嚴重瀆職的官吏沒一個坐牢，涉嫌操控「死人授權票」的黃碧嬌仍未被捕，黃之鋒的罪行難道比牠們嚴重？我瀏覽了近萬字的判刑書，想看看黃之鋒幹了什麼傷天害理的壞事，到頭來卻發現唯一的「罪證」，主要集中在判詞第35段，原來就是轉發羅冠聰的臉書貼文。 第35段列出黃之鋒九大「犯罪行為」，出現最頻密的字眼就是「The post was shared by the defendant on his Facebook page on the same day」，即「被告同日將該貼文轉載至他的臉書專頁」——「該貼文」是指羅冠聰的貼文。據判詞說，2020年7月至10月間，羅到英、美呼籲制裁中国及香港，並發起請願要求以色列公司Cellebrite停止向港警供應情報產品，黃則轉發相關貼文。 但光是轉發貼文，有必要判一個年輕人坐牢十年、毁掉他的大好青春嗎？或許連譚耀豪也覺得太欠缺說服力，所以必須把被告寫得更像個滿腹陰謀的「主腦」才行。怎寫呢？最麻煩的是，控方花五年蒐證，根本證明不到有任何外國組織或資金支持被告（見判詞第55段）。跟黎智英一樣，黃之鋒多年來被指「收美國佬錢」，如今經香港警方「fact check」，證實都是子虛烏有。 不知道譚耀豪思索多久，才想通怎樣扣黃之鋒的帽子。但他最後也勉強交到功課。譚在第35段指，當羅冠聰呼籲外國對港實施制裁、封鎖或敵對措施時，「被告的角色就是在香港提供『地下』支援（the defendant’s role was to provide his “underground” support in Hong Kong）」，引起外國關注，增強呼籲效果。譚耀豪為「underground」一字加上引號，似乎是因為他引用了黃之鋒2020年8月在英國《衛報》發表的一篇文章。 我查看該文，黃之鋒是這樣寫的： When certain slogans and songs are forbidden, the city’s protesters use wordplay, songs with Morse code messages, and blank sticky notes to express our grievances. Others even subvert the Chinese Communist party’s own dogma, or the first line of the Chinese anthem “Arise, ye who refuse to be slaves”. Since political organisations are the primary targets of the law, resistance must now go underground, with some, like Nathan Law, fleeing the city to keep speaking out in the international arena. （當某些口號和歌曲被禁，此城的示威者便改以文字遊戲、暗藏摩斯密碼訊息的歌曲，以及空白便利貼來表達不滿。有人甚至反過來挪用中共自身的教條，或国歌的首句「起來，不願做奴隸的人們」，藉此表達抗爭。由於政治組織是這條法律的主要打擊目標，抵抗運動如今只能轉入地下，部分人士則如羅冠聰那樣，逃離香港，繼續在國際舞台上發聲。） 只要不是斷章取義，任何人都明白黃之鋒所謂「go underground」，顯然是呼應前面所述的各種隱微的表達不滿的方式，即港府常常掛在嘴邊的「軟對抗」（不犯法的），而非暗示什麼驚天動地的大陰謀。問題是，判詞列舉的所有「罪行」，其實沒一項符合「underground」定義；也就是說，法庭根本從未證明黃之鋒為羅冠聰提供了任何「地下」支援。 眾所周知，「underground」是秘密的、不見光的，但黃之鋒的「罪行」全是在社交平台公開發布或轉發文章，光明正大，怎可能稱為「underground」呢？但欲加之罪既已無辭，譚耀豪為了交差，已懶理是否自相矛盾，就斷章取義抽出黃之鋒某篇文某個字，霸王硬上弓指黃轉發貼文，就是為羅冠聰提供「地下」支援，胡亂用一個引號便僭建罪名，彷彿兩人真有許多不見得光的勾當。 在正常法治社會，就算像羅冠聰那樣做國際遊說，公開呼籲外國政府向自己的國家施壓，也是合情合理合法的，何況僅僅是轉發貼文？去年9月英國改革黨黨魁法拉奇（Nigel Farage）赴美國國會作證，批評英國《網絡安全法》打壓言論自由，促請美國運用外交及貿易手段向英國施壓。時任英揆施紀賢批評法拉奇唱衰英國，甚至指他遊說美國制裁英國，直斥他不愛國。法拉奇否認要求正式制裁，但承認主張利用經濟及貿易槓桿，迫使英國改變政策。 羅冠聰所做的，和法拉奇差不多，英國政府有出動國安法把法拉奇收監嗎？沒有。如果黃之鋒真的有「罪」，那肯定不是唱衰香港，或支持那些被港官視為「不痛不癢」（曾國衛語）、「一笑置之，嗤之以鼻」（林鄭月娥語）、「完全沒有當是一回事」（鄧炳強語）的制裁，而是他把「国安法」實施後的香港看得太美好了，誤以為自己只要光明磊落，做一些全世界法治社會都合法的事，那就必定不會有問題。 黃之鋒「犯法」時，應該不知道自己正「犯法」，更想不到要重判十年。譚耀豪在第56段寫了一句，是判詞中少數我覺得有理的話：「被告唯一沒意識到的，就是他轉發LKC（羅冠聰）呼籲實施制裁的訊息這一行為，可以被用作證據，證明他與LKC及其他人串謀（The only thing that the defendant did not realize was that his acts of sharing LKC’s messages calling for sanctions could be used as evidence to prove his conspiracy with LKC and others）。」 轉發臉書貼文，居然是導致十年監禁的「串謀證據」，試問除了能夠百分百釘死被告的国安法官外，還有誰意識得到呢？ 相關文章 黃之鋒犯了什麼罪？ https://www.patreon.com/sefirot/posts/16850473 6

title: 澳门首宗国安案：澳门前民主派立法会议员区锦新获刑12年6个月
summary: （维权网信息中心报道） 2026 年 11 月 7 日，本网获悉：澳门首宗国安案：澳门前民主派立法会议员区锦新获刑 12 年 6 个月。 2026 年 11 月 6 日，澳门法院裁定 69 岁的区锦新五项罪名成立，包括“颠覆国家政权罪”、“与境外组织联系危害国家安全”及“违反保密罪”。 案件于 9 月闭门审理。区锦新自 2025 年 7 月被捕后一直被羁押。其家属此前表示，近一年无法与他联系，也无法自行委托辩护律师。 区锦新简历 ： 1957 年 4 月 30 日出生，葡萄牙
content: （维权网信息中心报道） 2026 年 11 月 7 日，本网获悉：澳门首宗国安案：澳门前民主派立法会议员区锦新获刑 12 年 6 个月。 2026 年 11 月 6 日，澳门法院裁定 69 岁的区锦新五项罪名成立，包括“颠覆国家政权罪”、“与境外组织联系危害国家安全”及“违反保密罪”。 案件于 9 月闭门审理。区锦新自 2025 年 7 月被捕后一直被羁押。其家属此前表示，近一年无法与他联系，也无法自行委托辩护律师。 区锦新简历 ： 1957 年 4 月 30 日出生，葡萄牙语名 Au Kam San ，祖籍广东新兴县，原葡属澳门籍、现中华人民共和国（澳门）和葡萄牙双国籍人，原为澳门青洲小学教师，后为知名社运人士，前“新澳门学社”创会成员，前澳门民主发展联委会理事长，“澳门小区发展新动力”会员大会副主席，澳门立法会议员，澳门民主派核心人物，中国在押政治犯。 自幼生长于澳门；大学时期，曾在澳门东亚大学攻读社会科学学士，毕业后又在中国大陆华南师范大学修读教育硕士；学成返回澳门，曾在澳门青洲小学任职教师； 1989 年，中国大陆发生八九民运，澳门有多个团体发起游行及各种声援行动，其因积极参与其中并加入论政团体“民主沙龙”（后更名为澳门民主发展联委会，简称民联会），但六四事件过后，其等多名民主派人士因受到诸如职业威胁、家庭压力和街头暴力袭击等多重压力而被迫辞职或被解雇，以致于民联会除其与吴国昌之外，成员多都四散；后其二人先后从政，透过直选而进入立法会，但其二人仍坚持举办六四悼念集会，直到该集会被中共澳门当局禁止； 1993 年，其开始担任澳门市政议员，四年以后，其又在澳门回归后连续 20 年担任五届立法会议员，直至 2021 年立法会选举宣布不寻求连任；在参加社运活动方面， 1992 年 7 月，其因与吴国昌等人成立民主派团体新澳门学社，以“立足于澳门，研究澳门社会状况，推动本地区现代化发展”为宗旨，以专业知识研究澳门社会的各方面议题，并充分利用立法会议员的权力，围绕澳门民生问题及政府施政失误提出了多个议案和反映市民的要求，故广泛得到民众支持，使该学社成为澳门最重要的民主派社团之一；数年后，新澳门学社内部因主张积极参与社运的“少壮派”与议会路线的“元老派”发生纷争，遂其于 2016 年 1 月致函学社会内，以“学社背离当年创办宗旨信念”为由退出了该社团组织，后又另组政党“澳门小区发展新动力”，并于次年成功连任立法会议员； 2018 年 9 月，其因就惹起外界疑虑的《通讯截取及保障法律制度》公开咨询接受媒体访问，质疑警方对他作出监听行为疑超越法律，认为“按法律，警方若监听电话，须先获法官批准”，并认为虽支持警方加强监督机制，但须有调查实权才能发挥作用，故而其言论被澳门保安司司长不点名指责，称其相关言论是“信口雌黄、胡乱猜测、犯诽谤罪”；后因其言论遭警方追究刑事责任，成为澳门回归后首例，故此事在坊间及网上迅速引起热议，人们均反感司警对事件的处理手法，几乎一面倒批评该做法不合理，同时也触动了对当地政府的不满情绪；针此，就有时事评论员指说，公众其实更有需要关注“在法律上如何健全监察机制和信息透明，以确保公众知情权和市民隐私等问题”； 2021 年 4 月 8 日，在立法会全体会议上，其因提及全国人大常委会通过修改香港有关选举制度，是在“摧毁香港民主普选制度”，故在发言提出后，就被施家伦、陈虹、崔世平等 5 名议员要求解释并收回言论，认为其所言片面，无视香港有人以分裂国家的方式争取民主； 2021 年，其因受压力而宣布不参加立法会选举（实因被指不效忠澳门特区被取消参选资格），至此结束其 20 年的立法会直选议员生涯。 2025 年 7 月 30 日，其突然被澳门司法警察局以涉嫌违反澳门《国安法》第 13 条“与澳门特别行政区以外的组织、团体或个人建立联系作出危害国家安全的行为罪”逮捕，次日移交检察院侦办；其被指控，“自从 2022 年起就涉嫌勾连多个境外反华组织，向对方提供大量不实且具煽动性的数据，作为境外及网上持续公开展览之用”，并在澳门《国安法》 2023 年生效后，还继续使用有关数据，以“协助他人收集或公然散布虚假及明显歪曲的消息等方式，引发他人对中国中央人民政府的仇恨、促成反华势力采取对中国及澳门特区的敌对行动，以及破坏澳门特区选举，严重危害国家安全”；其遭逮捕时，家也遭搜查，部分书籍被搜走，其妻子郑妙珊亦被带走，后被列为其案证人；针此，欧盟对外行动署立刻于同年 8 月 2 日发布声明，谴责澳门政府将其逮捕，批评此举加深了外界对澳门政治多元性和言论自由受侵蚀的担忧。 2026 年 11 月 6 日，澳门法院裁定 69 岁的区锦新五项罪名成立，包括“颠覆国家政权罪”、“与境外组织联系危害国家安全”及“违反保密罪”。案件于 9 月闭门审理。区锦新自 2025 年 7 月被捕后一直被羁押。其家属此前表示，近一年无法与他联系，也无法自行委托辩护律师。目前被羁押在澳门看守所。

title: Neros to expand domestic drone production with $450M Pentagon loan
zh_title: Neros 将利用五角大楼 4.5 亿美元贷款扩大国内无人机生产
summary: 总部位于加利福尼亚州的无人机制造商 Neros Technologies 是国防部小型无人机作战竞赛的领跑者，该公司从国防部获得了 4.5 亿美元的有条件贷款，用于扩大小型无人机零部件的国内制造。 Neros 增长主管 Ross Pederson 在接受《军事时报》采访时称，美国小型无人机行业的扩张“为美国纳税人带来了巨大利益”。他说：“我认为你不必太努力地让自己相信小型无人机在未来的战争中将非常非常重要。” “如果你看看状态
content:
总部位于加利福尼亚州的无人机制造商 Neros Technologies 是国防部小型无人机作战竞赛的领跑者，该公司从国防部获得了 4.5 亿美元的有条件贷款，用于扩大小型无人机零部件的国内制造。 Neros 增长主管 Ross Pederson 在接受《军事时报》采访时称，美国小型无人机行业的扩张“为美国纳税人带来了巨大利益”。他说：“我认为你不必太努力地让自己相信小型无人机在未来的战争中将非常非常重要。” “如果你看看以前的现状，那就是 99% 的产品都是中国制造的，这对美国来说是站不住脚的。”国防部战略资本办公室（OSC）提供了这笔贷款。 Neros 表示将额外投入 1.65 亿美元用于扩建，使总投资达到 6.15 亿美元。佩德森认为，OSC 向 Neros 和无人机制造商 PDW 提供的贷款（7 月份获得了 8.2 亿美元的贷款）将增强美国工业。他表示，中国“完全主导”了该行业，中国公司提供了绝大多数用于组装无人机的零部件。
OSC 主任兼国防部副部长高级顾问 David Lorch 在解释向 Neros 提供贷款的原因时表示，该公司“已经展示了设计、制造和提供卓越小型无人机系统的能力”。该公司是五角大楼无人机优势计划的领导者之一，该计划旨在寻找最优质、最实惠的小型作战无人机。“OSC 的投资将增强 Neros 制造无人机和对无人机系统至关重要的组件的能力，”洛尔奇在一份声明中补充道。过去一年，联邦政府还采取了其他措施来扩大国内小型无人机产业，从发起高调的竞赛到对进口无人机零部件征收关税。尽管特朗普政府对消费品广泛征收关税引起了批评，但无人机行业专家表示，进口关税有助于鼓励企业寻求国内替代品。 10 月，《无人机战士》一书的作者、无人机公司 POWERUS 的负责人布雷特·维利科维奇 (Brett Velicovich) 告诉《军事时报》，对无人机零部件征收关税是“白宫几十年来所做的最明智的事情之一”，该书记录了他在战斗中使用小型无人机的军事经验。他认为，美国通过出口限制给国内产业戴上了“手铐”，而中国面临的限制较少。
他说，这种不平衡帮助中国占领了小型无人机及其零部件全球绝大多数市场。维利科维奇表示，关税造成了零部件的瓶颈，“对每个人来说都很难”。但他认为，他们还推动国内企业“现在专注于符合（国防授权法）的零部件”，并“迫使我们所有人寻找新的供应链”。 “最终，这对美国有利，因为我们不能继续依赖中国。我们不能继续依赖这些系统，”他说。 2025 年 6 月 26 日，在阿拉斯加州费尔班克斯举行的国防创新单元测试活动中，Neros Technologies 首席执行官 Soren Monroe-Anderson（中）驾驶该公司的一架 Archer 无人机。 （考特尼·阿尔本）但据报道，关税不一定是军事客户国内采购的主要驱动力

【原文 English Original】
California-based drone maker Neros Technologies , a frontrunner in a Defense Department competition for small drones for combat, received a $450 million conditional loan from the DoD to expand domestic manufacturing of small drone components. In an interview with Military Times, Ross Pederson, Neros’ head of growth, called the expansion of the U.S. small drone industry “a huge benefit to the American taxpayer.” “I don’t think you have to squint too hard to convince yourself that small drones are going to be very, very important in the future of warfare,” he said. “And if you look at the status quo ante, which is that 99% of them are made in China, that’s not a tenable place for the U.S. to be.” The Defense Department’s Office of Strategic Capital, or OSC, provided the loan. Neros said it will commit an additional $165 million to the expansion, which brings the total investment to $615 million. Pederson argued that OSC loans to Neros and drone maker PDW, which received an $820 million loan in July, will strengthen the U.S. industry. China has “completely dominated” the sector, he said, with Chinese companies supplying the vast majority of components used to assemble drones. Explaining its reasoning for giving Neros the loan, David Lorch, director of the OSC and senior advisor to the deputy secretary of defense, said the company “has already demonstrated an ability to design, manufacture and deliver exceptional small unmanned aircraft systems.” The company is one of the leaders in the Pentagon’s Drone Dominance Program , a competition that seeks to find the best quality, most affordable small drone for combat. “OSC’s investment will turbocharge Neros’ ability to manufacture drones and components critical for the production of drone systems,” Lorch added in a statement . The federal government has taken other steps over the past year to expand the domestic small-drone industry, ranging from launching high-profile competitions to imposing tariffs on imported drone components . Although the Trump administration’s broad use of tariffs on consumer goods has drawn criticism , drone industry experts say the import duties have helped encourage companies to seek domestic alternatives. In October, Brett Velicovich — author of Drone Warrior, which documents his military experience using small drones in combat, and head of drone company POWERUS — told Military Times that tariffs on drone components were “one of the smartest things the White House has done in decades.” He argued that the U.S. had put “handcuffs” on its domestic industry through export restrictions, while China faced fewer constraints. That imbalance, he said, helped China capture the overwhelming majority of the global market for small drones and their components. The tariffs have created a bottleneck for components that has “been hard on everyone,” Velicovich said. But he argued that they have also pushed domestic companies to “now focus on ( National Defense Authorization Act )-compliant parts” and “forces all of us to find new supply chains.” “In the end, it’s what’s good for America because we can’t continue to be reliant on China. We can’t continue to be reliant on those systems,” he said. Neros Technologies CEO Soren Monroe-Anderson, center, flies one of the company’s Archer drones on June 26, 2025, during a Defense Innovation Unit test event in Fairbanks, Alaska. (Courtney Albon) But tariffs aren’t necessarily the main driver of domestic sourcing for military customers, according to Pederson. The Defense Department has long been prohibited from purchasing drones containing electronic components from certain foreign countries, including China, he said. “When it comes to that specific customer set, the tariffs aren’t necessarily the driving factor. It’s really the prohibition that the Department of War has on purchasing Chinese electronics,” he said. Before receiving the loan, Pederson explained, Neros didn’t manufacture its own components. Instead, it contracted other companies to manufacture parts that it then used to assemble drones. That is expected to change as the company expands its domestic production capabilities. Neros has already expanded its in-house motor production and will soon begin manufacturing surface-mount technology components, which are used to populate circuit boards, Pederson said. “By late next year, somewhere in the like 80% by dollar value of the drone should be made in-house, like in the same physical space where the drones are being assembled,” he said. Pederson declined to provide specifics about the loan’s terms, including its interest rate and repayment timeline, but he said it is not subject to loan forgiveness and that the Defense Department has manufacturing goals for the company. “They’re all centered on making these components in the United States and making them available broadly to the market, not just to ourselves,” he said.

title: General Atomics Ranger UUV to Support Large Payloads, UAVs
zh_title: 通用原子公司 Ranger UUV 支持大型有效载荷、无人机
summary: 在 Euronaval 2026 上，通用原子公司展示了其 Ranger 和 GA-Ray 远程 UUV，专为多年任务以及发射子无人机和有效载荷而设计。通用原子公司 Ranger 和 GA-Ray 无人水下航行器将支持潜射无人机和广泛的有效载荷模块，以执行监视、采矿和打击任务。在 Euronaval 2026 上，《海军新闻》采访了 GA 电磁系统公司海事项目副总裁 Rolf Ziesing，了解通用原子公司的海底无人开发项目。 “我们对这个 UUV 项目感到非常兴奋。我们正在解决一个关键需求
content:
在 Euronaval 2026 上，通用原子公司展示了其 Ranger 和 GA-Ray 远程 UUV，专为多年任务以及发射子无人机和有效载荷而设计。通用原子公司 Ranger 和 GA-Ray 无人水下航行器将支持潜射无人机和广泛的有效载荷模块，以执行监视、采矿和打击任务。在 Euronaval 2026 上，《海军新闻》采访了 GA 电磁系统公司海事项目副总裁 Rolf Ziesing，了解通用原子公司的海底无人开发项目。 “我们对这个 UUV 项目感到非常兴奋。我们正在解决 UUV 领域的一个关键需求，即续航能力和任务范围。为了解决这些问题，我们开发了一种动力能源系统，使 UUV 能够运行多年或数万公里，”Ziesing 说。 Ziesing 解释说，该公司正在努力将概念工作扩大到 100 至 135 英尺长的 UUV，能够携带更多无人机和其他有效载荷。与传统的基于螺旋桨的推进方法相比，通用原子公司选择了浮力滑翔机设计来增加航程和耐力。 Ranger 和 GA-Ray 为此使用推进器和专门设计的控制面。 General Atomic 概念图强调了滑翔机型 UUV 使用冲绳和关岛发射点的射程。从这些基地位置，无人潜航器可以到达第一岛链的咽喉要道或中国大陆沿岸的水域。
“仅将关岛作为行动中心，我们正在考虑向西太平洋地区秘密运送一架飞行器以支持任务行动。相对于当今现有的 LDUUV 和 XLUUV，这种滑翔机的射程和到达范围要大几个数量级。这确实是一个关键需求，需要运送有效载荷并让平台长时间停留在驻地。” Rolf Ziesing，GA 电磁系统公司海事项目副总裁 通过该设计的增程部署和任务续航能力，Ziesing 强调了 Ranger 和 GA-Ray 可以携带的有效载荷的潜力。 “滑翔机船是可扩展的。我们现在有一艘 22 英尺长的两用船。我们现在用它来降低风险和概念开发。同时，它是部署这些小型 UUV 的有用平台。我们将把 22 英尺平台扩展到 100 英尺翼展平台，该平台将具有货运能力，相当于 CONEX 箱的大小。在该货舱中，可以携带各种有效载荷，”Ziesing 说。无人机、UUV 有效载荷通用原子公司潜射四轴飞行器无人机。 General Atomics 图形 通用原子公司正在利用这些较小的 UUV 开发各种功能和有效载荷。在 Euronaval 2026 上，通用原子公司展示了他们开发的潜射四轴飞行器无人机。
一段真实测试的视频显示了无人机从管道中的部署，该管道将从通过 Ranger 或 GA-Ray 部署的 UUV 发射。该无人机的规格尚未向海军新闻透露。 Ranger 和 GA-Ray 型 UUV 的图形表示根据变体的大小可以携带多少小型水下无人机。根据描述，有效载荷可以在 16 到 96 个子 UUV 之间变化。 “我们确实将其视为一个 UUV 系统。因此，我们有一个大型主机 UUV，旨在携带有效载荷。有效载荷是我们开发的另一艘 UUV，我们已经操作过这两种 UUV。

【原文 English Original】
At Euronaval 2026, General Atomics revealed its Ranger and GA-Ray long-range UUVs, built for multi-year missions and launching sub-drones and payloads. General Atomics Ranger and GA-Ray unmanned underwater vehicles will support submarine-launched drones and extensive payload modules to address surveillance, mining and strike missions. At Euronaval 2026, Naval News talked with Rolf Ziesing, Vice President of Maritime Programs at GA Electromagnetic Systems, to learn about General Atomics undersea unmanned developments. “We’re very excited with this UUV program. We’re addressing a critical need in the UUV space, which is endurance and mission reach. To solve those problems, we’ve developed a power energy system that will allow UUV to operate for multiple years or tens of thousands of kilometers,” said Ziesing. Ziesing explained that the company is working to scale up concept work into a 100 to 135-foot UUV capable of carrying additional drones and other payloads. Compared to traditional propeller-based propulsion methods, General Atomics opted for the buoyancy-derived glider design to increase range and endurance. Ranger and GA-Ray utilize thrusters and specially designed control surfaces for this purpose. A General Atomic concept graphics highlighted the range of the glider-type UUV using a launch point from Okinawa and Guam. From these basing locations, the UUVs can reach First Island Chain chokepoints or waters within the littorals of mainland China. “Just looking at Guam as a center of operation, we’re looking at delivering a vehicle covertly to the Western Pacific region to support mission operations. Relative to the existing LDUUV and XLUUV of today, the range and reach of this glider is orders and magnitude greater. That’s really a critical need, to deliver payload and have a platform stay on station for extended periods of time.” Rolf Ziesing, Vice President of Maritime Programs at GA Electromagnetic Systems Through the design’s extended-range deployment and mission endurance possibilities, Ziesing emphasized the potential of the payloads that can be carried by Ranger and GA-Ray. “The glider ship is scalable. We have a 22-foot vessel now that’s dual-purpose. We’re using it now for risk reduction and concept development. At the same time, its a useful platform to deploy these smaller UUVs. We will scale the 22-foot platform up to a 100-foot wingspan platform that will have cargo capacity – the equivalent size of a CONEX box. In that cargo bay, there is a variety of payloads that can be carried ,” said Ziesing. UAV, UUV Payloads General Atomics submarine-launched quadcopter UAV. General Atomics graphic From these smaller UUVs, General Atomics is developing a variety of capabilities and payloads. At Euronaval 2026, General Atomics showcased their development of a submarine-launched quadcopter unmanned aerial vehicle. A video of a real-life test shows the deployment of the UAV from a tube that will be launched from the UUV deployed via Ranger or GA-Ray. The specifications of this UAV were not disclosed to Naval News . A graphic of Ranger and GA-Ray type UUVs denotes how many of the smaller underwater drones can be carried depending on the size of the variant. According to the depiction, the payload can vary between 16 to 96 sub-UUVs. “We’re really looking at this as a system of UUVs. So we have a large host UUV, which is intended to carry the payload. The payload is another UUV that we have developed and we have operated both of these at-sea,” said Ziesing. Aside from the sub-UUVs, at least two large displacement drones of an unspecified variant or a containerized payload can also be deployed carried. “It can transport two large diameter UUVs that can then do their own missions. Or it can drop the CONEX box to remain on station. Or it can just sit at the bottom with the CONEX box, with the door that opens at the top, to deploy different payloads to deliver different types of effects,” said Ziesing. “It’s intended to deliver very large cargo payloads for a variety of missions. So it can stay on mission, stay covert and energize on command to support mission operations.” General Atomics previously showed a concept of maintaining an extended patrol of dual-sonar array equipped Ranger UUVs off the North American West Coast to protect the continental U.S. Ranger, GA-Ray Potential Amid New U.S. Navy Plans Ranger and GA-Ray notional operational ranges. General Atomics photos The American defense firm’s modular underwater gliders come amid new demands from the U.S. Navy’s Hedge Force Strategy. Debuted by Chief of Naval Operations Daryl Caudle at Surface Navy Association 2026, the sea service plans to combine unmanned systems with warships, aircraft and submarines to tailored “hedges” against specific adversaries. General Atomics claims that these UUVs can take on missions previously handled by nuclear attack boats and provide multi-month to multi-year on-station endurance to commanders. These include mining, surveillance and anti-submarine missions. Tests held to date include operations while submerged lasting up to 70 days to simulated the type of missions General Atomics anticipates for the drones. Going forward, Ziesing told Naval News that the company’s UUV work has attracted “many interested parties.” “There’s a lot of interest. The payloads we’re developing are very unique and novel. You can image that there are other payloads we are developing that we’re not going to talk about. And because of the ability to deliver these payloads covertly for extended periods of time, there’s a lot of interest.” The post General Atomics Ranger UUV to Support Large Payloads, UAVs appeared first on Naval News .

title: Iranian press review: Newspapers warn of war reaching 'heart of Europe'
zh_title: 伊朗媒体评论：报纸警告战争将蔓延到“欧洲心脏”
summary: 伊朗媒体评论：报纸警告战争将蔓延至“欧洲心脏” 由MEE通讯员于周一提交，2026年9月11日 - 11:02 与此同时，一份报告称共和党在国会的失败不会阻止特朗普的军事行动，中国成为结束战争努力的潜在参与者 《哈姆沙赫里日报》于 2026 年 11 月 3 日在头版发布了一张欧洲地图，标出了美国在英国、德国、法国、意大利、罗马尼亚、希腊、阿尔巴尼亚和葡萄牙作为“伊朗武装部队的目标银行”（截图） 与伊朗革命卫队相关的媒体公布了欧洲潜在目标清单
content:
伊朗媒体评论：报纸警告战争将蔓延至“欧洲心脏” 由MEE通讯员于周一提交，2026年9月11日 - 11:02 与此同时，一份报告称共和党在国会的失败不会阻止特朗普的军事行动，中国成为结束战争努力的潜在参与者 《哈姆沙赫里日报》于 2026 年 11 月 3 日在头版发布了一张欧洲地图，标出了美国在英国、德国、法国、意大利、罗马尼亚、希腊、阿尔巴尼亚和葡萄牙作为“伊朗武装部队的目标银行”（屏幕截图） 与伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队相关的媒体发布了欧洲潜在目标清单 继美国上周袭击格什姆岛之后，与伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队 (IRGC) 关系密切的日报公布了欧洲各地的潜在目标清单。这些报道发布之际，人们对美国可能重返伊朗战争的猜测越来越多。周二，《哈姆沙里日报》在头版发布了一张欧洲地图，将美国在英国、德国、法国、意大利、罗马尼亚、希腊、阿尔巴尼亚和葡萄牙使用的基地标记为“伊朗武装部队的目标银行”。哈姆沙里借用了该国最高领袖哈梅内伊之前使用的术语，将伊朗的新军事战略描述为“不受地理限制的对抗”。该报写道，根据这一战略，“美国的支持中心、空军和海军基地以及欧洲的后勤基础设施已被列为潜在目标”。
(adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});总编辑由最高领导人任命的《凯汉日报》也发出警告，称如果美国不接受伊朗提出的和平协议条件，“战事的地域将扩大到欧洲心脏地带和海外基地纵深”。报告补充说，伊朗对美国、以色列及其盟友的军事学说已经变得“更加直接和更具攻击性”。凯汉特别指出，在参与对伊朗战争的欧洲国家中，英国发挥了“最关键和最突出的作用”。 2026年伊朗会重蹈伊拉克2006年的覆辙吗？伊朗高级官员对共和党在美国中期选举中失利表示欢迎，认为这是对唐纳德·特朗普总统鹰派政策的打击，新闻网站 Khabar Online 将其与美国领导的占领伊拉克期间举行的 2006 年中期选举进行了比较。 “铁门计划只是文字游戏”：伊朗嘲笑美国中断供应路线的军事举措阅读更多»哈巴尔在线在其报告中警告说，“国会多数派的变化和对战争政策的反对并不一定意味着总统立即撤退或结束军事行动”。该报告回顾了共和党在时任总统乔治·W·布什领导下的类似失败，并探讨了其对伊拉克战争的影响，包括美国总统用于继续军事行动的广泛权力。
它还审视了2006年之后美国在伊拉克的军事行动，当时华盛顿增加了驻地部队的数量。报告称，“一些战争反对者的预期是，民主党的胜利将为美军迅速从伊拉克撤军铺平道路。但接下来几个月发生的情况却恰恰相反。” Khabar Online 通过比较得出结论：“布什的经验表明，如果没有政治团结和克服总统否决的能力，即使是国会中反战的多数派也无法独自阻止政府的军事进程。”以色列试图

Iranian press review: Newspapers warn of war reaching 'heart of Europe' Submitted by MEE correspondent on Mon, 11/09/2026 - 11:02 Meanwhile, a report says Republican losses in Congress will not stop Trump's military campaign, and China emerges as a potential player in efforts to end the war The Hamshahri daily published a map of Europe on its front page on 3 November 2026, marking US bases in the UK, Germany, France, Italy, Romania, Greece, Albania and Portugal as the 'target bank of the Iranian armed forces' (screengrab) Off IRGC-linked outlets publish list of potential targets in Europe Daily newspapers close to Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) have published a list of potential targets across Europe, following US strikes on Qeshm Island last week. The reports came as speculation grows over a possible return of the US to the war with Iran. On Tuesday, the Hamshahri daily published a map of Europe on its front page, marking US-used bases in the UK, Germany, France, Italy, Romania, Greece, Albania and Portugal as the “target bank of the Iranian armed forces”. Hamshahri described Iran’s new military strategy as one “of confrontation without geographical limits”, borrowing a term the country's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei previously used. Under this strategy, the daily wrote, “US support centres, air and naval bases, and logistical infrastructure in Europe have been raised as potential targets”. (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({}); The Kayhan daily, whose editor is appointed by the supreme leader, also issued a warning. It said that if the US did not accept Iran’s conditions for a peace deal, “the geography of the battle will expand to the heart of Europe and the depth of overseas bases”. It added that Iran’s military doctrine towards the US, Israel and their allies had become “more direct and more offensive”. Among European countries involved in the war against Iran, Kayhan singled out the UK, saying it had played “the most key and prominent role”. Could Iraq's 2006 experience be repeated in Iran in 2026? As senior Iranian officials welcomed the Republican Party's defeat in the US midterm elections as a blow to President Donald Trump's hawkish policies, the news website Khabar Online drew comparisons with the 2006 midterms, held during the US-led occupation of Iraq . 'Iron Gate plan is merely wordplay': Iran mocks US military initiative to disrupt supply routes Read More » In its report, Khabar Online warned that “a change in the congressional majority and opposition to war policies do not necessarily mean an immediate retreat by the president or an end to military operations”. The report recalled the Republican Party's similar defeat under the then president, George W Bush, and examined its impact on the war in Iraq, including the extensive powers the US president used to continue military operations. It also looked at US military operations in Iraq after 2006, when Washington increased the number of troops on the ground. “The expectation of some opponents of the war was that a Democratic victory would pave the way for a rapid withdrawal of US forces from Iraq. But what happened in the following months was the opposite,” the report said. Drawing on the comparison, Khabar Online concluded: “The Bush experience shows that even an anti-war majority in Congress cannot, on its own, stop the government's military course without political unity and the ability to overcome a presidential veto.” Israel sought to break up Iran, former Israeli negotiator says Daniel Levy, an Israeli peace negotiator who took part in the 1993 Oslo-B talks, said Israel's reasons for launching a new war against Iran on 28 February were to break it up and follow a policy similar to what happened in Iraq and Syria. “Israel's goal was the collapse of the state, the creation of chaos in Iran and the break-up of the country - something similar to what we saw in Iraq and Syria,” he said in an interview with BBC Persian. Leak reportedly exposed Netanyahu and Mossad chief's plan to attack Iran before Israeli election Read More » He added: “I don't think the Israelis themselves even believed their own propaganda narrative that regime change could be achieved in Iran.” On the plan to divide Iran, Levy also pointed to reports in the early days of the war about weapons being sent to Iranian Kurdish opposition groups in Iraq. He said the initial idea was to establish a liberated area inside Iran, where resources and military forces could be concentrated to continue the war against the central government. Levy also referred to Reza Pahlavi, the son of Iran's deposed shah, who had received public support from Tel Aviv since Israel's 2025 attack on Iran. He described Israel's backing of Pahlavi as a temporary strategy aimed at advancing its longer-term goals. “The Pahlavi family was a useful tool for Israel. A tool for creating chaos. I don't believe they thought the end result would be regime change. I don't even think they considered that a desirable outcome,” he said. Tehran looks to Beijing as war diplomacy intensifies Speculation is growing over China 's possible role in efforts to secure a ceasefire between Iran and the US, as diplomatic contacts between Tehran, Beijing and Muscat point to a possible new channel for negotiations. The pro-reformist Shargh daily reported that security official Ali Bagheri Kani's recent meetings in Beijing could signal the creation of “a parallel diplomatic path” led by China and Oman. Shargh added: “Bagheri Kani's visit, within this framework, could be part of Tehran's consultations to assess new diplomatic initiatives and explore the capacity of influential countries to prevent the crisis from escalating.” (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({}); Meanwhile, the conservative Jame Jam daily also covered Bagheri Kani's visit, describing it as part of Iran's efforts to bring Beijing and Moscow on board with its regional policies. According to Jame Jam, Tehran's diplomatic efforts and consultations with China and Russia , alongside the use of mediators such as Qatar and Pakistan , are part of Iran's attempt to manage the war it has faced since February. However, the daily stressed that statements of support from China and Russia alone could not prevent the conflict from continuing. It said the effectiveness of their policies depended on practical action to prevent US unilateralism in the region.
